review_text:
The restaurant is very spacious and airy, I like the table settings, although I feel like the couch was too low and made eating a bit difficult, but overall, the aesthetic of the restaurant is nice. I especially like the bathroom, it was clean!

Service was very swift and the waiter was friendly too. We ordered the spring rolls and fried rice with peppered chicken, grilled/barbecued chicken and strawberry milkshakes.

The spring rolls were the best thing we ordered. It tased really good and the sauce that came with it really complimented it too. It was just the right amount of savoury and spicy, we genuinely enjoyed it. The fried rice was VERY BLAND! The chicken, both the peppered and grilled/barbecued chicken, were VERY DRY! Chewing it took so much effort, we did not enjoy it at all. The milkshake tasted like a mixture of milk and red colouring powder with a lot of sugar. Nothing about it felt like a strawberry milkshake in my opinion.

In total, we paid about #54,000 which I think was overpriced for the food we had. If it had tasted better, maybe it would have been worth the price. Overall, the food was very underwhelming, I don’t think I’ll be visiting again

The waitress was very patient and lovely , she attended to us well. The food was so good , giving it a 10/10 but the milkshake , the Oreos milkshake was tasting more like chocolate milkshake, the Oreos only one was inside so a 4/10 the strawberry milkshake was a 8/10. The food came really fast though the waiting period wasn’t long at all mine came in 10mins but I think this depends on the food you are  ordering. Love the Ambience was giving family restaurant vibes 🙂will definitely be going back there !
It’s more of an Indian restaurant

I was there for the first time, and I can confidently say it is a 10/10 experience. You truly get value for your money. The manager is exceptional in terms of customer relations, and that positive attitude clearly reflects in the professionalism and conduct of the entire staff.

Cilantro was an amazing experience from start to finish. We didn’t have to wait for a table and the staff welcomed us warmly and made us feel right at home. Among the many restaurants I’ve visited in Lagos, Cilantro’s staff stood out for their friendliness, patience and helpfulness.

The restaurant itself is spacious and beautifully designed, with aesthetic details that truly deserve a 10 out of 10. We had a party of about ten, and we found a large seating area that was perfect for our group.

When it came to the food, everything was delicious. I had the half chicken, which was flavorful and perfectly cooked. But what truly blew me away was the dessert: the chocolate brownie was sizzling and delicious, paired with cold ice cream, creating the perfect contrast. It was, without a doubt, the best dessert I’ve had on the mainland and it’s definitely made me eager to return for more.

It was a pleasant experience, despite the unforeseen circumstances. Although there were power issues, causing a brief delay, the overall experience was quite positive. The team handled the situation with professionalism and a commitment to resolving the problem. Their dedication to providing excellent service was truly commendable. The resolution to the power issue was handled efficiently, which was a great relief. The staff’s polite and helpful approach made a significant difference. The experience certainly left a lasting impression.

The street style burger was sumptuous. The Mac and Beef, Delicious.
Every bite was relished and gave maximum satisfaction.
Then the customer service is top notch. I love how every waiter looks out to satisfy every customer, ensuring all goes well. Lovely ambience, water front view and decent play area for young children.

Cactus is a multi cuisine restaurant in VI, Lagos. Ambience is cozy and friendly. Their outdoor dining is awesome. Nicely maintained and comfortable as well as their service.

Taste of food is good. Portion size compared to price is small. Liked their Nachos Shrimp and Marinara Pasta.

Jollof Rice is so so. But kids mean combination is good.

Overall good experience.

Stunning waterfront views with lots of space indoors, outdoors and on the premises. Lovely desert options and designs used across all dining spaces are innovative and very refined. Prices are also great with delicious ice cream. Enjoy #lagos.

Cautious services.  Good delicious food. I love the salad and my kids enjoyed the kids menu asking for more.
Bathroom is clean without odors. Except for the afternoon heat, outdoors with the water view is so refreshing.  Parking might be a problem but you will be sorted out.

Nice family place. Food was good. All the sandwich and warp was big in portion. We loved the bbq platter. Ordered another one after the first one. It was smaller than expected. It came fast. Service was good till we almost finished eating. Our busboy was very insistent to clean out our table while there was still food to be eaten. We refused the first time but after 10 min when he came we told him to give us time and to relax.
Place is very noisy than other places. Kids are running around inside the restaurant despite having a play area. They need to work on this.

Very aesthetic spot with great vibes and live music. Nice for drinks and small bites, but not ideal for main dishes. The Beef Milanese didn’t match the description — not crispy, beef was dry, and the mash lacked creaminess. Prawn salad was good, drinks were okay but a bit sweet. Better as a bar than a proper restaurant.

I had an amazing dinner here — everything was just perfect. The food was truly exceptional and the cocktails were incredible. Their risotto was honestly one of the best I’ve had in a long time.

Beautiful atmosphere, top-notch service, and unforgettable flavors.
Highly recommend! 👌🏽✨

You would not even know that there is a restaurant here. Even after parking inside, it still didn’t look like a restaurant, it looked like a big house, until we entered inside and voila!

It is an aesthetically pleasing space, very spacious and well decorated. As soon as we entered, one of the waiters led us straight to our table and presented us with the menu almost immediately. Waiter was very friendly and had a smile on his face every time.

The highlight for me was the food and cocktails. The cocktails were to die for! I thoroughly enjoyed my cocktail (I can’t remember the one I ordered tbh) and of course I had a taste of my husband’s too, it was really lovey. For food, I ordered the lamb chops with rice and my husband ordered the rib eye stake with potatoes. The food was so delicious! The lamb chops were very well seasoned, the rice tasted so nice too. I can’t fault the food and drinks to be honest.

Our bill came to a total of #254,000 which I think is quite pricey.

The only reason they don’t get 5 stars from me is because they didn’t allow flash photography. We went there for date night, I dressed up looking all cute and could not get one single photo in there because as soon as you enter, there’s a “no flash photography” sign written somewhere. I was told I could take a picture in the corridor, but the lighting there was not great and there was nothing exactly cute about the corridor, so it wasn’t worth it.

10/10 experience. One of the best places to go for great food, service and ambiance. SLoW makes me feel like I’m abroad due to the level of hospitality and atmosphere. Great job to the owner and staff! Highly recommend getting the Salmon on Peruvian Rice, and asking for pepper sauce for that extra tasty kick.

Very high standard of food and pastry. While the decor and service are impeccable, we found the place extremely noisy and the exposed concrete ceiling style doesn't help absorb any of the noise unfortunately. However, by 9:30 pm, the place had calmed down considerably.

One of our favorite spots in Lagos. Food was amazing — especially the salmon fillet, perfectly cooked with crispy skin and not dry at all. Drinks and desserts were great too. It does get quite noisy and the tables are wide, making conversation a bit hard, but overall a great place for dinner, drinks, and good vibes.

Lovely spot. Definitely for the well heeled. Quiet ambiance. Lovely japanese style food. A lot of western dishes as well. Follows the trend of amazing meals. My only complaint and this is more of a cultural thing- rare and medium rare do not exist. Most times your food is well done. Possibly a preference of the clientele. The location and the layout however more than make up for this small oversight.

Another good spot for food on the island. Great options with seafood, lamb, Australian cuts and pasta but pls dont try the creamy mushrom pasta. Its rubbish. We asked the chef to re-check but he did not seem to care.

If you’re visiting Nigeria and looking for a spot with a serene atmosphere and a truly abundant dining experience, RSVP Lagos is the place to be. The chef has an incredible way of balancing and elevating flavors, making every dish feel special.

My family and I arrived without a reservation, yet we were warmly welcomed, seated promptly, and attentively taken care of. The team even prepared a custom sauce just for me to accommodate my dietary restrictions—a thoughtful touch that made the meal even more enjoyable.

The dessert was something else entirely—the coconut sorbet I ordered was absolutely mouthwatering and the perfect finish to the evening.

I genuinely appreciated having a relaxing night out, free from dishes and full of delicious food. Would I go back? Absolutely. There are still so many tempting dishes on the menu waiting to be explored.

The only downside was the absence of a baby changing room, which made it a bit challenging to change my 6-month-old.

Beautiful esthetics
Attentive staff and very prompt
Food was very nice
A little pricy but portion sizes were okay and the food nice

This place is just amazing. Host was so friendly and welcoming, order taker to food serving to closing was amazing.

Tried their Soup and it was great, Shrimp Tempura 🍤 was good, Sushi was not that great but not bad either as well as Salad. Liked their special fried rice and lastly the dessert and it was delicious.

Overall great experience. We enjoyed.

Service - Service was 💯. The waitress was friendly and knowledgeable. She was able to answer questions about the dishes and also recommend.
Food - Food came out in a timely manner and they were hot. Spices were balanced and what was ordered /seen was what was served. Drinks were on point as well.
Atmosphere - nice and spacious. Perfect for content creators to take loads of pictures and make videos. I would have preferred the restaurant to be a bit cool ( especially if you are coming in from blazing sun)
Overall. Had a great time with family and definitely will be back soon
Beautiful Japanese inspired restaurant with giant and beautiful statues. Fair pricing, great food with a culture rich approach to interior design. Enjoy #lagos

The restuarant has a very nice ambience. Different meals are served. From breakfast to main meals to desserts and snacks. There is also kids menu to choose from. Food was great and very filling. Nice customer service. Our attendant Mary was very lovely. Enough parking space.

If you are like me who doesnt have an adventurous taste buds, just stick to what you are familiar with lol. I had the 'grilled fish' and chips and honestly I didnt enjoy the fish because it didnt taste like what I am used to lol so maybe another thing to do is ask the waiters questions but luckily the sauce from my starter was a great help to eat it.

Other than that, it was a good experience.

Restaurant is located next to the Hard Rock Cafe at the Landmark center in Oniru. Lagos. First time visiting. Location is ok- some stores are closed due to the closure of the beach near by and construction of the Calabar coastal road.

Inside decor and back area were impressive, but within a short time, traffic on the coastal road might be an issue- noise wise.

Restaurant is neat, staff are very welcoming, waiter was attentive, restrooms are neat and functional.

Wasn’t impressed with food or drink ordered- none tasted right. Bland and not expected taste and texture. Coming from a location where I’m surrounded by the best Asian restaurants, I must say these were a no-no. Ordered- Tom Kha soup, vegetable string rolls, spicy prawns and risotto.

Right next to me was a mother and her kids who came in for the Sushi brunch, and they complained about their meals too. But they did state, they believe the Chef must have been changed since this is the first time they’ve had a bland meal at the restaurant- they frequent the restaurant a lot. So, I’m hoping my next visit to the restaurant would be different-

The meals were quite pricey for the quality.

Overall, atmosphere is 👍🏽

Update- September 5, 2025- revisited location 6 days after on Saturday since we agreed on having sushi for dinner. Again, atmosphere was great. Got served by the same friendly server from last week…I believe his name is Victor and we did order the Shashimi, maki platter, eel sushi, and some drinks.
I did enjoy the meal and drink- a big contrast to the non-sushi meals I had previously. I guess Sushi should be the focus at this restaurant…
(Sorry, pictures came out blurry and not able to post)…

Will definitely be back👌🏾

I recently visited this restaurant and had an experience worth sharing. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt warm and inviting, and the food turned out to be just as impressive—flavorful, well-prepared, and simply enjoyable.

What truly made the visit exceptional, though, was the service. Our waitress, Blessing (Favour) Linus, was outstanding. She carried herself with genuine professionalism and an easy, beautiful smile that made the whole experience even more pleasant. She checked in at the right moments, cleared the table thoughtfully, and made sure we were comfortable without ever feeling rushed. It’s clear she takes pride in her work, and it showed in every interaction.

Service like hers is the kind that makes you look forward to returning. Combine that with great food and a lovely ambience, and it’s safe to say I’ll definitely be back.

Always love being here, nice atmosphere. Food is good . Love their starters spring rolls . Love their burgers. You can work here , have a date here. I had my birthday here few years back really loved the experience. Good food.
Second time here and I love it here. The food is always good and over the top music.
Overall, I had a good experience! I’d love it even more if the waiters could offer great meal recommendations. It would really take dine-in  experience to the next level

Casper & Gambini’s at ICM Ikeja is a pretty cool spot! I went for breakfast and had the English breakfast, fresh fruits, and a pineapple drink. The drink was freshly squeezed, so that was definitely a win. 🔥

The customer service was great, and my meal arrived earlier than expected, which is always a plus. The price per person was around ₦30,000 ($20)—fair for the experience.

The only downside was a few flies hovering around, but the attendants quickly brought out the electric fly zapper and handled it. Overall, a good experience, and I’d definitely visit again!

The bryanni made me sick all night and I ended up vomiting. I have never vomited as an adult, EVER, but the experience I had was terrible and scary. The rest of the food was good. The experience and staff was good. We (3 people) ordered everything we wanted (a lot) and paid #150k in 2024

Very disappointing experience. I ordered a meal with a salad, only to sit there for almost 30 minutes before being told the salad couldn’t be made because ingredients were missing. Why take the order in the first place if the kitchen isn’t stocked or the staff isn’t informed?

To make matters worse, I came with a 9-year-old child and his mother, and the restaurant served the child a mocktail instead of a simple, appropriate beverage. That alone shows a serious lack of judgment and professionalism.

Poor communication, poor service, and zero attention to basic customer responsibility. This place needs better training and much better management. Definitely not worth the time or money.

Awesome customer service from the time I was greeted by Chiamaka, to being served by Kevin.
My food was prepared fresh and to my dietary needs. To make the experience even better Vincent stopped by  to ensure that the service was of the highest quality.
Thank you for an awesome dining experience!

Great food and atmosphere spoiled by absolutely horrendously poor service

I really dislike when the rating of a great restaurant is pulled down by their server staff, but this place deserves better (wait staff!).

The food is excellent. If you are willing to endure a 3 hour dinner of only two courses, with poor service this place is for you.

The buffet restaurant downstairs is a better choice if you are on a time crunch.

I really wish this place would value its customers rather than taking for granted that their clientele is a captive audience.

Wakame felt incredibly warm and cozy. The decor was lovely, and the whole place had a great, inviting feel. Especially the lighting, which was soft and just right.

The music was also perfect; quiet and not too loud, which made it easy to relax and chat. I can't even remember if we heard music, lol.

The wait staff were good too, attentive and helpful.

For my food, I had the beef tenderloin with jasmine rice, and it was amazing! The beef was super tender and cooked perfectly, and the sauce was delicious.

My friend ordered noodles, but they didn't really like theirs; it might have just been that type of noodle or maybe they just didn't like it.

The only real downside was the wait. Our drinks came fast, but it took about 40 minutes for our main dishes to arrive, which was a bit long.

Still, I enjoyed the experience overall!

I have to say, their customer service was one of the top notch things I enjoyed about the place.

The server was nice, polite and helpful. I went there for a bridal shower and they took group pictures and videos of us when we asked.

Every single thing was top notch. The chicken was amazing. The fried rice was not quite as amazing, but still good. It was a wonderful experience. I'd love to come again.

I recommended the Grid to hubby and he absolutely loved it! I have been here before I was suprised to see they are now in building directly opposite. The ambience was everything.

We were politely attended to by nice Gina who took our orders. She recommended the oreos milkshake I had and I absolutely loved it. The smoky jollof rice was really delicious we had to order more of the sides.

We were given chin chin while we waited for our meal, this was really thoughtful. Another thing to note was that the meals came rather faster than we thought.

Lastly we got complementary chapman 😁.

We absolutely recommend.

A very good atmosphere and ambience
There was no service delay , good and amazing aesthetics.
The food was great and the environment was calm and friendly 😁

Been here a couple times, atmosphere is okay, service really good,food was okay as well. Parking space can be tight. (Ikeja)

Their location in Yaba, I was there once and it was quite disappointing . They had only 20% of the menu. We had to settle for chips . Their excuse was cause it was a new location and they are just starting
Very good ambiance, Karaoke on thursday and Dj. The place is so crowded seats for 4 people are given to 10

I had a very good time dining here. I enjoyed my food, it tastes so so good, portion is generous which I love and I couldn’t get enough of the food.

Service is excellent ✅ as a sucker for good service, I enjoyed the way they treat customers.

Ambiance is cozy.

It’s a perfect place to relax, eat good food and have a good time.

I love it here.

I totally enjoyed the meal. Sunday is not the best day to visit as it was overcrowded. No space anywhere for even a single person as I was there by myself.

The waiters, barman and attendants were very busy as the bar stand kept filling up with cups that needed to be cleaned and prepped.

I had to wait for 10minutes before I could even get water by the bar stand. Had to wait an additional 25 minutes to get a single seat.

The meal took over 30minutes to be ready as I had ordered Pineapple Special Fried Rice. The barman on duty was polite and kind. I totally loved how he made the Virgin Mojito. It had a sizzling feel undertone.
The meal was worth every minute of wait time and I totally enjoyed it.
Ordered the large size and I couldn't finish it cause the portion can conveniently feed two adults. Had to pack up the left over as takeout.

The only challenge was that because the place was very full and people kept going in and out, the place was hot and there were flies stressing people out.

Overall, it was a fair experience because of the meal served. Not sure I would do it again except I try during a week day to see what difference it makes.

This restaurant is nicely tucked away in Ikeja Gra : lovely ambience, quiet , courteous staff , good food that comes in large potions . It’s ideal for dates , group gatherings or business meetings. I got value for money and spent around 45k+ naira for food and fresh juice for 2 people . You can also request for takeaway incase you didn’t finish your portion .  There are also lots of spots to take really nice pictures . I’d for sure visit again .

Alice Gardens stands out as a dedicated and serene venue tucked away within the exclusive Government Reserved Area (GRA) of Ikeja, Lagos. It is frequently sought after for mid-sized events, retreats, and private accommodation, offering a welcome respite from the chaos of Lagos life.

Location & Ambiance (⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐)

The primary strength of Alice Gardens is its strategic location. Being situated in Ikeja GRA immediately grants it high-end security, immaculate surroundings, and excellent road network access, yet it remains relatively peaceful.

The ambiance itself lives up to the "Gardens" name. The property is characterized by:

Lush, well-maintained greenery that provides a cool, aesthetic backdrop for photos and relaxation.

A calm, low-traffic atmosphere perfect for corporate training, intimate weddings, or quiet stays.

Service and Facilities (⭐⭐⭐⭐)

The facilities, while perhaps not ultra-modern, are impeccably clean and functional. The staff are often commended for being attentive, professional, and courteous, embodying the standard expected in the GRA environment.

Accommodation: The rooms/suites (if applicable) are usually described as comfortable, well-kempt, and offering sufficient amenities.

Event Space: The garden area is versatile, providing a beautiful outdoor space complemented by indoor halls or covered areas for backup.

Power: Consistent power supply is a standard feature, crucial for maintaining comfort and event logistics.

Security and Serenity (⭐⭐⭐⭐)

The combination of the GRA security presence and the private security measures at Alice Gardens ensures a high degree of safety. This serenity is often the main draw, as guests feel completely removed from the city's intensity, allowing for maximum focus whether for business or leisure.

Summary and Recommendation

Alice Gardens successfully delivers on its promise of tranquil, professional service in one of Lagos's most desirable neighborhoods. It’s an ideal choice for anyone prioritizing security, dedicated service, and a lush, serene environment for an event or a stay.

While some facilities might be due for a modern upgrade, the impeccable standards of cleanliness and outstanding location more than compensate, making it an excellent and reliable choice in Ikeja GRA.

Overall Rating: 4.5 / 5 Stars

The food here is amazing!!! the ambience of the place is top notch, everywhere is so cute and calm and beautiful, you can take pictures as well. for birthdays the staff come out and sing happy birthday and they sing so beautifully it’s amazing. and the staff are also really nice, my waiter took so many pictures of me i regret not getting his name. again, the food is amaze!! this place is 10/10 i would deffs be visiting again and again!!

The meals came less than an hour surprisingly. The fish was tasty same as the soup for the swallow but the meat was tough and tasted like it was going bad.
The service by Glory was better compared to the last person who attended to us the previous time we were there. The place needs more fans that actually work and are cleaned often. The potato fries that came with the grilled croaker fish looked like it was fried in old oil cause it had black tiny particles on it. I'd say this time was a little better than the last which means they are improving and can get better.
The music was majorly Christian songs and it was good. I enjoyed it

Thank you.

First time in Lagos and I tried this place with my family, big mistake. The place looked good on the outside but was dirty once you got up close. Smelled like sewage the entire time, flies all over the place, the tables weren’t fully clean. There was only 1 waiter for 5 tables and they only had half the menu available (not her fault, I blame upper management doing a terrible job). The food itself took over an hour to come and came wrapped in plastic. You could tell the fried rice and jollof rice were not fresh, and that the chicken wasn’t fully cooked through. Overall not a good spot to go to unless you want to wait an hour for cheap, barely available, half cooked food in a sewage smelling restaurant. Paid about 38k in total and won’t be going back.

Really nice spot to relax, gospel music playing in the background. Great for couples, friends, or family hangouts.
Usually packed, though, so finding convenient seating might be a bit of an issue, but you can resera table. That's a bit pricey, though.
Food is great and relatively inexpensive. Service is fast too. Food is freshly made, so wait time is usually between 30-50 minutes.
Overall a nice spot. Would highly recommend!

The environment is serene with calm music and has a great setting if you need a quiet place to eat and drink especially at night but their Manager Mr L was extremely rude.  If you don't have the mind for pepper, avoid their asun ... In all, it's a nice relaxation spot.

The Meat Pie is to die for!!🔥 The Pies (Beef & Chicken) is exquisitely delightful!!
Chocolate shake wasn't so bad too.

Atmosphere and ambience of the place is quiet serene; it's a great place - owned by renowned Gospel Artist Buchi.

Visited the Lagoon on a Thursday which happened to be the popular seafood night. The place was packed. There were long waits without reservation.. So book in advance.

The experience was selecting fresh seafood to be grilled or fried. If you are a seafood eater. This is near to heaven. There was a very wide range fish and shelled fresh fish - lobsters, crabs, prawns, octopus,  calamari and  a variety of fish.  We selected a few and had another 30 minutes wait for it to arrive.  The best was the Crab. Highly recommended. It was in a delicious vegetable sauce. Went well with the friend Rice. The other fish required a sauce which was unfortunately not provided.

The server were friendly but disorganised. It took 20 minutes before they took our drinks order. Another 15 minutes for starters.

I will return but maybe earlier in the day when I can relax and watch the  bird fly across the Lagoon while cracking my lobster tail.

The view is beautiful at night time, it is a nice place for a group hangout. Enjoyed the Bloody Mary mocktail with the Alfredo pasta...turned out to be a good combo with the spiciness in the drink complimenting the creamy pasta. Would have liked if the pepper sauce was spicily-sweet.

Lagoon Restaurant has a beautiful waterfront ambiance that immediately stands out and creates a relaxing dining experience. The setting is perfect for a calm outing or a special meal by the water. While the fish was fresh, it lacked enough spice to truly stand out. However, the crab sauce was absolutely world-class—rich, flavorful, and perfectly paired with rice and small chops. Overall, the ambiance and standout sauces make it worth a visit, with room for improvement on the fish seasoning.

This place hides some wonderful surprises. One Thursday evening, we showed up not knowing they had a catch-of-the-day fish display, where you get to select your own fish. We chose two tuna, which they prepared and served as sashimi—an absolutely outstanding experience. Along with them we had Japanese rice, appetizers, and a bottle of white wine.

Beyond that, the atmosphere is excellent, and the service is both friendly and professional. I truly enjoy Lagoon Restaurant and highly recommend it.
Good atmosphere, may enjoy the views of ocean Laguna, evening views is awesome can have enjoy with friends also good for party 🥳 plac.

This is the second time I’ve been here in a litter over a year. It takes too long for the food to come out, even simple appetizers. Both times I’ve been here the waiter has returned like 20 minutes later to tell me they didn’t have something; this time it was cabbage for coleslaw.
The food was either cool or lukewarm; the wings, the calamari, the ofada, the club sandwich (cold toast is terrible).
The best thing was the casa sangria.
This is one of my top restaurants in Lagos . The ambience is great , the food is amazing . My go to order will always be the jerk chicken and coconut rice . It hits every time 🔥

Came here on my holiday with a group of my friends. The first thing I noticed was how friendly the staff were. I loved the food and drinks. ESPECIALLY the drinks, their attention to detail is unmatched. Sadly I stay in Abuja, can’t wait to come back to Lagos so I can go there again

The House is a restaurant you don't want to miss. Here's why it stands out:

✨ Ambience✨

The House has a refined and relaxed atmosphere that sets the stage for a memorable evening. It strikes a good balance between classy and down-to-earth, making it a great place to enjoy a meal.

✨ Service✨

The staff at The House is friendly and attentive and ensures you feel welcome. They provide excellent service without being overbearing, allowing you to enjoy your dining experience fully.

✨ Food✨

The dishes at The House are expertly prepared and full of flavour.  And the menu offers a variety of options to suit different tastes.

✨ Price✨

While The House is not the most budget-friendly option, you get what you pay for. The overall experience, including the ambience, service, and delectable food, justifies the price.

If you're looking for a special place to enjoy a delicious meal, be sure to give The House a try.

I had visited once with friends at night, but it didn’t feel like an actual experience.

So, I went back there today with my partner and the manager took us round, it was an amazing experience.

If you love cozy, warm and private, the house is definitely the place to be.
It was dark inside, so we couldn’t take photos inside. Every room was a total experience and it had this intimate feel. You can literally sleep and cover up with duvet (we saw people doing this, so it’s an actual thing there). It’s indeed “The house”.

I particularly love the food, it’s African and western at the same time. We ended up sitting outside.

The waiters were very polite and we didn’t leave till late at night.

The House is perfect for friends hangout, house party, lovers night out, if you love your privacy and like to be alone. A couple came with their kids (I didn’t think that was wise majorly because people were really smoking outside and I particularly felt the kids were too young to be inhaling all that).

The only reason I am rating The House 4 star is because the music outside was too loud.

Had our departmental end of year party her and it was all shades of good vibes. They have a space for hosting events, and we went for their buffet option, which cost around 40k per head(this is inclusive of a mocktail). We all had a good time. The food was pretty decent. The staff were courteous.

It was a good one and I would definitely revisit for a personal outing.

The ambient was great, the waiter and waitress were friendly however, the following makes the overall rating to be below one star:

1.   The cutlery sets were already laid out for 5 seater table which were permanently set out instead of laying them on arrival of diners.

2.  The pockets of the cutlery were dirty.

3.  We were initially taken to a table where 3 laid cutlery sets were already used and not cleaned and we were expected to sit at the unused 2 sets of cutlery while they attempted to clean the used sets.

4. After complaining, we were taken to another 5 seater table and we ate while the other 3 cutlery sets were still laid meaning that we ate over the laid unused cutlery sets. Other innocent victims will be forced to use the unclean cutlery.

5.  The 3 course meal was bland and tasteless. We did not get value for money after spending about N134,000

Cilantro is easy and accurate to locate using Google maps even though it's not close to the main road. Starting from the gate to the car park down to the restaurant and leisure area behind, the scenery is quite impressive. It even takes a step further in ambience when it gets dark. I give the scenery and atmosphere a solid 8/10. As for the food, I didn't have a variety but the ones I got were all well prepared. I had different juice selections there and I am guessing them were freshly squeezed because of their taste (didn't confirm though). The only con for me here is parking, not much space the the parking lot. But it's a worthy tradeoff. My experience here was really solid. I highly recommend! 💯

The food was okay, but it took too long to come out and it also didn’t come out warm. The ambience is definitely their biggest selling point very well decorated area. There was no corner of the restaurant that you can’t take a photo in, but the prices were island prices, I won’t sugar coat it.

The staff were polite, prompt and smart. We were immediately guided to a seat on arrival, and our orders were taken correctly.

The starters and main meal were promptly served within 25 minutes of ordering and it was a delightful symphony of flavors. The mocktail ordered was also great. While the music was a little loud, it wasn’t intrusive and didn’t ruin the ambience.

It was an enjoyable experience and I would love to go again.  ✨

Warning: It's not good at all. The pasta sauce is very tasteless. A Western restaurant can't even make a basic seafood pasta well. It's hard to give it a good review. The price is not low. Also, the meat platter took a long time to come out. When it was served, the beef inside was cold.

This breakfast place is beautiful
Decor is fab it’s hidden away on a gated estate.
It would be on a 5 from me if the food never took so long to come.
I think even some people come after us, got fed before us.
I would still come back for the food and atmosphere . Lovely place

Food is a 10. The service we received from Temitope was phenomenal! Definitely a 10! Atmosphere is a 10! Loved that we could sit outside, work and eat. Really great restaurant! Also their signature cocktail is phenomenal!

From the gate it was chaos as the gateman was aggressive.
The picture attached is what they called the Mixed grill and it had just a single drum stick , a cut of lamb chops. Apparently there was no sirloin and just a piece of prawn was added as a replacement without me being informed.
As an establishment, people should get value for money being spent.
The platter was replaced with a better option eventually. The Thai fried rice tasted good but would not recommend due to overall experience.
Loved everything about this restaurant.. the food was so exciting and delicious.

​I visited La Taverna recently and had an overall above-average experience. The food was definitely the highlight—everything we ordered was very tasty and well-presented. The flavors are authentic and hit the right spot.
​The ambience is okay—pleasant enough for a casual dinner. However, the service could definitely be improved. Despite the restaurant not being busy when we arrived, we waited quite a while to be attended to. Even throughout the meal, getting service wasn't very prompt.
​Great spot if you aren't in a hurry and want a delicious meal, but I hope they can sharpen up their response times!

La Taverna felt like an Italian downtown restaurant. It's a beautiful space with good food. The only the u wasn't so comfortable with was the wait time to get attended to or having to scout around to look for the person attending to your table. If possible, the owners can get a table bell or indicator so guest can use the botton to notify the servers. Overall, it was a good experience and affordable prices.

Reminds me of an old Italian movie. A nice blend of rustic and modern with lots of greenery. This restaurant is very calming.  And price was a surprise.  Quite affordable. Meal were nice but not as spicy as i would prefer. The pizza and desert though was excellent. Love the service.
PS- Very nice smelling rest rooms.  Definitely a plus
4/5

I had a lovely experience at La Taverna. It was a bit tricky finding parking at first, but once I got in, everything else made up for it. The restaurant has both indoor and outdoor seating. I chose to sit outside and really enjoyed the serene atmosphere. The customer experience was great, and the food arrived right on time. Meals were affordable, portions were good, and there are plenty of nice photo spots too. Definitely worth visiting again.
Had a team bonding lunch here. Food was good although not as seasoned as I would have like but the portion was sizable. Like the atmosphere, very intimate.

Service, staff & food was amazing. Really enjoyed this restaurant. One of few that do great with carry out by Courier pickup- this is impressive and important for days we don’t want to leave the house.

The A steakhouse, Victoria Island.
Standout features:
Unique latin american design.
Laid back setting, ideal for solo dates.
Gated compound, lots of different dining spaces.
International chefs, likely internationally owned.
Very classy interiors, very intricate.

A truly underwhelming experience. For a place named A Steakhouse, the steak was a 1 out of 10. I requested well-done, not burnt, but what I got was burnt. Considering the steak alone cost me N85,000, I expected far better quality.

The mocktails were just colored water with ice—absolutely no real flavor. I was too annoyed to even complain, but the waiter’s dodgy moves made things worse. Clearly aware that the steak was bad, he approached me to ask if my steak was good and when I said no, he tried to shift the blame to me. He claimed that the steak got burnt because I didn’t remove it from the hot plate immediately after it was served. If that was so important, why didn’t he mention it when bringing the food? Instead, he waited until it was ruined. Of course I am sure it was already burnt straight from the grill. Note that I only left the steak on the hot plate for less than a minute to take a picture.

If using a hot plate ruins the food, why not stop using it? I’ve eaten at plenty of restaurants that serve on hot plates without this issue. Overall, this was a disappointing and overpriced meal. I definitely won’t be returning.

Service staff were great. The menu prices are not for the faint of heart. But the atmosphere gets you. Classy, with careibean vibes music playing in the background. The outdoor seating area is delightful, with the added touch of fresh greenery and even lemons growing right there in the garden.

All in all a lovely lunch.
Love the outdoors, over all amazing place

The food was the best thing about this restaurant, trust me when I say it was good! The aroma, the taste, the plating, it was so good. Which is why I’m rating it with 5 stars

Now while the food was great, the service could use some serious work! The waiters were so unenthusiastic! They worked sluggishly and sloppily, one almost dropped my friend’s food!

The food prep time also wasn’t satisfactory at all, we had to wait 25-30 minutes to get our food. That’s still a relatively long time, but I’ll give credit for serving the food within the time frame they gave, most restaurants say 20-30 mins and take 1hr to actually serve the food.

Overall, I had a wonderful experience at the restaurant with my friends, we were even a little reluctant to leave😂

The BEST Nigerian restaurant that serves everything you could desire - in such high-quality approach. Authentically cooked and delicious! Since we’ve been in this country, we have eaten here at least five times, as we stayed at the Marriott in Ikeja.

Yellow Chilli Ikeja never disappoints! I had lunch here and it was absolutely great. The seafood okra was rich, flavorful, and generously packed with fresh seafood, and the pounded yam was smooth, soft, and perfectly made. Every bite felt comforting and satisfying.

The ambiance was warm and inviting, service was prompt, and the overall experience was top-notch. If you’re looking for authentic Nigerian cuisine done right in Ikeja, Yellow Chilli is definitely a must-visit. I’ll be back for sure! 🍲✨

I always get their jollof fiesta everytime I go there and it’s delicious to pair with a virgin piña coloda
My date also had their banga and it was really satisfying. Although it would help to increase their portion size for swallow because it’s a waste to order another portion of swallow and not being able to finish it cos the first portion was small.

Poor service from the waiter, food tasted awful, small quantity and definitely not worth the price at all. I guess their staple meal just might be the seafood okro and banga (which is for Wednesdays and Fridays), I do not recommend anything else.

I visited Placebo with my friends for dinner and we were genuinely impressed. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, the food was delicious, and the service was excellent. A special mention to Joseph, who attended to us throughout, he was polite, attentive and made sure we had everything we needed. His service really stood out and contributed to how much we enjoyed our evening.

We had a wonderful time at Placebo and I’ll definitely be visiting again. Highly recommended.
I actually enjoyed my birthday here. The food was amazing and their  services was top tier 😍 Will definitely come back again

Their meal 10/10
The service here was really welcoming
The chefs are really talented
This is my 5th time here I just had to drop a review
It was memorable, the menus was top notch 🥰🥰the milkshake is 10/10 .. the customer service was great 😊 beautiful smiley faces all around

First time guest. Frankly the gentleman waiter(forgot his name) was quite exceptional and very helpful.

Unfortunately, after 30mins of waiting after placing our order, the kitchen calls him to inform him that there was an emergency which had to do with no gas to cook. Asking that we wait for upwards of an extra 35mins to figure out how to resolve this. Even appetiser wasn't available.

We had to leave without eating. I still hold that the professionalism of the waiter was noteworthy. However the kitchen staff behaviour and slip-up in planning messed the entire experience up.

Prices look fair (I was looking forward to lambchops and mashed potato(recommended by waiter)) ambience was good.

Won't most likely be returning.

I love this place so much ... The food is delicious and very affordable... But two people can't share a portion or manage a portion when it comes to the sauce.. The atmosphere is refreshing..  I recommend the butter Nana...

Pondicheri serves top tier Indian food in Lagos. I had the biryani, butter naan and chicken masala and everything tasted amazing!

The spice was just right and the naan was so buttery. The portions were also very reasonable and could honestly feed two people.
I got so caught up with the food, I didn't even remember to take photos! I will definitely be going back there
Very nice food, service, and ambience. Great customer service!
the food here is so delicious and palatable the service is 100% and the ambiance is so beautiful ❤️❤️❤️

Today , I  had the pleasure of dining at Pondicheri, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience! The moment I walked in, I was struck by the warm and inviting atmosphere. The decor was modern and chic, with a touch of south India .

But what truly stole the show was the food. I ordered the  chilli chicken , fish , prawns and they were cooked to perfection - crispy, flavorful, and served with a side of delicious chutneys. The service was also top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff who made sure our glasses were always full.

What I loved most about Pondicheri was the creative twist on traditional Indian cuisine. The chef's use of fresh, locally-sourced ingredients and innovative flavor combinations made for a truly memorable meal. The manager Mr.Rangaswamy was very friendly and  made sure everything was perfect

Overall, I highly recommend Pondicheri to anyone looking for a unique and delicious dining experience. Can't wait to go back!"

*Rating:* 5/5 stars

*Price Range:* Moderate (15000-30,000Naira)

*Recommended for:* Foodies, Indian cuisine lovers, brunch, lunch, dinner

The space was filled at the main restaurant and had to move us to their lounge; Prive which I wasn't too sad about. The food came late and I was a little frustrated.

Ordered the Cajun Seared Barracuda and it was perfectly done, toasty on the outside and soft on the inside. I did not find a single bone in the fish, which was impressive. Absolutely delicious. 9/10

I initially wanted mashed potatoes as my side, but since it was not available, I opted for jollof rice and honestly I am glad I did. This was hands down the best basmati jollof I have ever had. Smoky, firewood flavoured, not overly peppery and incredibly tasty. 11/10

My sister had the Ofada, which was delicious and generously loaded with proteins. However, it would have been even better with Ayamase sauce. 7/10

Our waiter David was very understanding and offered excellent service, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

For drinks, the mojito was a standout. The lemon and mint hit perfectly. It was refreshing, balanced and very well made. 10/10

The strawberry daiquiri was nice but nothing particularly special. 7/10

Dessert was the chocolate mocha cake. The cake itself was warm, soft and delicious, and the chocolate syrup was really good. Unfortunately, the ice cream had melted by the time it arrived and was more foam than ice cream, which took away from the experience. 6/10

The yam fries were toast outside and soft inside. The tomato sauce was delicious 7/10

Cannot end the review without talking about the dj at the Prive lounge! He was so good and made us dance in our seats.

Overall, I will definitely be coming back, mainly for that jollof and the mojito alone. They should hold their chef well! They are doing a good job.

I absolutely loved the food, it tasted really nice.
The customer service was absolutely great too. It was top notch.

Again, the food there was really nice.

I had the Zesty Lemon Wings, Asundodo, Catfish pepper soup and Afang and semo
Has the guava cocktail drink TWICE, it was that nice.
Food was 10/10 and the atmosphere is amazing. Love the free fries we got. The mocktail was so amazing. I went for a second and the jollof!!!! Standing ovation pls. Food is expensive though

This is my second time at Nest. While I didn’t quite enjoy the food on my first visit, I’m happy to say there’s been a lot of improvement. The food was much better this time—flavorful, well-prepared, and served in generous portions. The overall experience was definitely more enjoyable. Kudos to the team for stepping up! Looking forward to coming back again.

I had a very disappointing experience at NEST Lagos. We waited almost an hour for our food, with repeated promises from the staff that it was “coming soon.” In the end, we had to take some items to go because of the delay. Drinks did arrive, but the only gesture offered for the inconvenience was a single complimentary drink.

Nigerian restaurants need to do better—stop overpromising and underdelivering. Great service isn’t just about the food, it’s about respecting customers’ time. Unfortunately, NEST Lagos fell short on both.
Pretty chill place theres at arcade at the top floor, a karaoke bar at the first floor and lots of eateries. Also, there's a silverware cinema at the top floor

Beautifully built two-flat residential property offering comfort, space, and modern design. Each flat features well-finished rooms, spacious living areas, fitted kitchens, and clean bathrooms. Located in a serene and secure neighborhood with easy access to major roads and nearby landmarks. Perfect for families or investors seeking quality and convenience

Ikeja City Mall (ICM) is a popular, convenient spot for shopping (Shoprite), dining (KFC, Ocean Basket, Krispy Kreme, Chicken Republic), and entertainment (Silverbird Cinemas), attracting many shoppers with a good mix of brands, regular events, and a pleasant atmosphere, though it can get crowded, especially on weekends, with some users noting specific food deals or cinema loyalty programs.
Convenient and secured in the heart of the city. Gives you a range of options for a good shopping experience
Great place. I only wish there was a place to sit without having to buy anything.

place_name: The City Mall Lagos Island Lagos
review_text: If you're an art person, then you'll love this place...... just be sure to bring your snacks along cause it can be a bit difficult to get food

place_name: The City Mall Lagos Island Lagos
review_text: Was lovely and cool place to always visite

place_name: The City Mall Lagos Island Lagos
review_text:
This has got to be my 3rd time here and I must say I'm impressed that businesses still exist within the mall.

The foot traffic here is not so high. If that sounds like a thing to you, then this could be a great spot for people who want to spend time away from prying eyes or who avoid crowded malls like me.

The restrooms are clean and well taken care of and I am happy the management has improved on some of the facility especially the air conditioning. It's not chilling cool but it's slightly better than the hot hall that welcomed me on my second visit 2 years ago. Hence the 4 star.

place_name: The City Mall Lagos Island Lagos
review_text: It's a big mall with adequate parking space. The KFC outlet in it is neat and spacious enough to host hangouts, dates and meetings. Their high seats are also a favorite.

place_name: The City Mall Lagos Island Lagos
review_text: This has got to be the most quiet mall I have ever visited in Nigeria. The traffic of people coming in and out is not very high so if you are thinking of going to a place not very crowded then this may work for you. At the time of my visit it had a functioning escalator. They have quite a number of stores to service customers; there’s a phone store, eye clinic, perfume shop, cinema, game place , different restaurants and loads more.

The last time I remember shopping here was 10 years ago. I visited briefly few years ago. I visited again few weeks ago and was impressed that the facilities are still very well maintained. Also, the 3 floors are stocked with modern products and their parking building is still super!
Real Luxury is where you can get authentic watches like Rolexes, Patek Philip, etc. For a lower budget, perfumes can be bought.

Mega Plaza is truly a standout shopping destination right in the heart of Victoria Island. From the moment you step inside, you’re greeted with a wide selection of high-quality products across various categories, ensuring something for everyone. What really sets Mega Plaza apart, though, is their exceptional customer service. The staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and always ready to assist, making every shopping trip smooth and enjoyable. Whether you’re looking for the latest fashion, electronics, or everyday essentials, Mega Plaza offers a convenient, pleasant, and reliable shopping experience. It’s definitely my go-to spot on Victoria Island. Don't forget by 9:58 pm they close

Mega Plaza as the name implies has everything household you can think of or even imagine. One of the best Mall in Lagos State situated in Victoria Island. It has wheelchair accessible entrance and it's easy to navigate your way around the stalls. It has a food court with amazing menu list and quite affordable.
During their peaks hours, parking space could be a bit challenging. But I totally love the place..

A lovely plaza that deals with variety of stuff. On the ground floor, we have swatches by the entrance to the left and Office land to the right. Further down, we have office R plus that deals with furniture and other office upholstery. Med plus, a pharmacy is opposite the office land.
Office land deals office supplies that ranges from notes to gadgets. A 9mobile outlet is by the entrance too.
The car park is opposite the plaza with a four storey storage unit for cars. Just before the mega plaza is the office land that houses most of their furniture.

This mall is great. It has a wide variety of stores and kiosks selling everything from clothes to electronics.
The prices are reasonable, and the mall is clean and well-maintained.
There are plenty of food options and seating areas. The staff is friendly, and security is good.

I would recommend it to anyone looking for a good shopping experience.

The palms is an excellent place for shopping, hangout, dates, movies and meals with love.
Enjoy the best The Palms Shopping Mall offer.
Great inside the mall and outside too. Got a burger here and was so sweet ❤️

Palms Mall is a dependable “one‑stop” destination in Lekki—well maintained, secure, and offering a solid mix of shopping and entertainment, especially for groceries and cinema. It’s ideal for solo or small‑group trips, but families with young children may find it limited unless planning for a movie. The food court could use more variety and better value, but overall, it’s a flagship retail destination for the area.

A Fading Echo of Its Former Glory
The Palms Mall used to be a vibrant, bustling space full of energy, variety, and excitement. But stepping in recently felt like walking through a memory. The atmosphere has changed, and not for the better. Stores once lively now sit quiet or empty. It’s a shadow of the place I once knew, and I’m honestly in shock. Something special feels lost.

Great place to be. I went to meet up some friends on a Sunday evening. The place has an elevator and built with standard aesthetics. It houses good restaurants, a good cinema, beautiful rooftop lounge, and many more exciting businesses. The parking space is impressive and the location is just along the road.

This is a great mall that is yet to meet its full potential. At this level it is already get a lot of attractions. So far I've only visited the cinema and it is a wonderful experience. Beautiful aesthetics and well laid out structure. The screens are massive me the seats are so comfy.

I look forward to visiting this for other attractions, which I believe will equally be a great experience.

Visiting Sky Mall is always refreshing. The mall has a modern and welcoming atmosphere, with clean interiors, well-arranged shops, and a calm environment for shopping and relaxation. From fashion stores to supermarkets and eateries, it offers a variety of options that make shopping convenient.

What I enjoyed most was the balance between leisure and shopping. You can stroll through the mall, pick up what you need, and also take time to relax at the food court or lounge areas. The security and orderliness also add to the comfort, making Sky Mall a nice place to spend time with family or friends.

I think this is one of the finer malls I've so far seen in lagos but why do they hassle breastfeeding moms on the terrace? You eat, the kids are eating too... What's ya deal? Zip it!

Really beautiful design spaces. Toilets 🚻 neat,
Functioning (though real creaky) escalators,
Different eating areas,
Different shops,
Views that look out far and out into lagos,
Really beautiful!
Nice music too.

Just stop shaming nursing mothers who come to have fun like everyone else. Anyone offended should leave.
How's it ever okay 👌 for one to smoke but a kid can't feed? Can't even be allowed on the terrace?
Was with some family 👪 groups and it just was stupid.

I visited Rosticks in Skymall Ajah. The restaurant 🍴 is situated at the to floor of the building just beside the cinema 🎦 spot and adjacent to the smoothie spot.
What is liked -- I love the variety of their food and fact that I had a lot to choose from. The rice really tastes and looks nice hence I had to go for two different rice they had. The chicken was well fried and tasted nice as well with the bone been very soft and easy to chew. The atmosphere was conducive, well lighted and the air conditioner was fairly functional. The attendants were nice and fast and served us what we ordered for in less than 3 minutes.
What I observed -- I was bothered by flies while enjoying my meal and that made the lose one star 🌟. The air-conditioning wasn't as effective as the one in the rest room probably because the door to the balcony was open - probably. They did not have plantain at the time of our order which I feel is not cool since we arrived there at about 17.00 GMT.
Conclusion - In general Rosticks is a good place to take yourself, friend, babe and family 👪 to and enjoy their variety of delicacies when you have the time. Lastly, I don't know if they have a branch on the mainland because if they don't, then only those on the Island gets to enjoy their amazing food and customer service.

Good place to hangout with Family and friends.
There's a cinema and nice restaurants there.
This is definitely a one stop location on Lagos Mainland for shopping and restaurants. My friends and I visited Casper and Gambini. They have a great platter.
The mall has lost its touch. Extremely dirty. No cleaners around and it was extremely crowded, very understandable that it was Christmas season though. This should be looked into
Cool place where you can watch movies, relax, unwind and do grocery shopping.

Great chill and hangout location.
Especially with friends and family
Oh..yes and em ...spouse too

Highlights are:
Filmhouse cinema
Food court offering wide range of vendors including
Debonairs, Cold stone, and others.
Arcade gaming centers
Virtual reality
Shopping mall

Turn offs:
Sometimes it's just dead.
You'll always run into your Ex. 😂

Lennox Mall is a well-organized and modern shopping spot in Lekki. It has a good mix of stores, dining options, and entertainment. The environment is clean, secure, and easy to navigate. Parking is decent, and overall it offers a convenient shopping experience.

The Mall is smaller than other popular ones in Lagos, however, it is kept clean. The mall floor is not crowded by different vendor stands and some store units are still empty.
Hans & Rene, SAS textiles and Atmosphere are some of the companies at the mall.
Parking available but limited, between 15 to 30 cars can be parked.

It's a large mall that houses Mood Lagos and a host of other businesses. It has a conducive parking with helpful security guards.

A bit of it was still under reconstruction during my last visit.

It's the defination of a well functional mall with about three floors. It's well ventilated and houses so many businesses. Here you can find fashion boutiques, laundromat (WashRyte), wristwatch shop, mobile phone shops, aromatherapy outfits, wine and drink shops (Radon wine and spirits),  play zone (virtual reality gaming center), lingerie shops, perfume shops (Sydney),  Chinese eatery ( Shifu), fabric shop and so much more. Moving up the floors is easy cause it's got an elevator. Whatever you're looking for in Lekki phase 1 and environ, you might likely find in Lennox mall. Oh yeah, since it's Christmas season, there a beautiful Bath and Home shop called Crystals Bath Accessories, you can get some very high quality items for your home and bathroom from scented candles to ornaments, Christmas gift ideas etc

Functional facilities with very helpful security assistants.

Spots to have a full day. From a cafe to a laundromat and supermarket and rooftop restaurant, the mall has enough amenities and locations to keep you engaged without the need of leaving the building

Parking and service is top notch.

reviewer_name: Ann Robinson Holistic and wellness therapist
review_text: The mall is a decent place with enough parking space. The only issue is the small traffic at the entrance. It causes a lot of traffic on that road. If the security men can be more swift about gate passes, I think it can cob the traffic in.

Jara Mall Ikeja is a great place to shop, eat, and be entertained. There are a variety of stores to choose from, including a grocery store, a pharmacy, and a clothing store. The mall also has a food court with a variety of restaurants. In addition, there is a movie theater and a game arcade. Jara Mall Ikeja is a great place to spend a day or an evening.
Here are some of the things I like about Jara Mall Ikeja:
* The variety of stores
* The food court
* The movie theater
* The game arcade
I would recommend Jara Mall Ikeja to anyone looking for a place to shop, eat, and be entertained.

It was okay. Not the biggest mall I’ve been to but they had a court to sit and eat which was pretty cool. They don’t have alot of eateries though. The food at the Kilimanjaro there is terrible. Indomie cafe as well. I’d recommend Dominos or KFC

It’s a very spacious mall. I think I just like the fact that it wasn’t too crowded when I went ,  despite the fact that it was a holiday . It has a huge parking space too like the other big mall in the Ikeja ( you know the one I’m talking about ). And it has some really cool brands inside too... a gelato company... pizza and ice cream, cinema ... a bakery too I think( things typical of a Lagos mall) . At the time when I went , there were still spaces up for rent so I’m sure we haven’t seen all that the mall has to offer . All in all, it’s a nice place.

Jara Shopping Mall is a great place for both quick stops and full shopping runs. The supermarket section is well stocked with groceries, fresh produce, household items, and essentials at reasonable prices. They also run promos often, which makes shopping more exciting. The mall is clean, organized, and has a relaxed atmosphere, with a few other outlets and eateries around for convenience. Staff are polite, though service can be a bit slow during peak periods. Parking is decent but can get tight on weekends. Overall, it’s a budget-friendly and family-friendly place to shop in comfort.
It's a whole world of experience on its own.. So many sight seeing.

Escalators don't work.
Need more popular restaurants. Only The Place is there.

The Mall used to be a real live wire but it has now succumbed to a lot of what plagues Nigerian businesses such as Electricity supply and hanging around of 'undesirable elements'.
It is a real shame because I love the mall but now not so much.
Yin yang restaurant and skate city at Maryland mall are a must try and excellent for family time

Purple Maryland is quite a lovely place to hangout and a fun place. Is located within a major road and close to a Pedestrian Bridge. Is a place where you can bring kids to, it has electronic staircase. And multiple businesses are housed here like stores, eateries, cinemas (Genesis cinema), medics. Front of the Mall is a big electronic billboard when at night it illuminate the major road and the pedestrian bridge. There are some couples of games you can play here for Adults and Children.

Good place to buy plain and cotton fabrics. Calico too if you're a tailor. Mainland alternative to Balogun. Like every other Nigerian market, it's difficult to locate specific places here, even with the numbering. The overhead bridge makes it very difficult to use public transport to and fro here.

Overall, a much better organised market than most Nigerian markets.
I Sell Gold and diamond jewelries at tejuosho ultra modern market, home of affordable and original luxuries. Tested and trusted.

Can be rowdy, but it's a nice place to grab some grub....
Though getting there can be tricky for someone who hasn't been there before
It's was a great shopping experience escorted my friend to get some fabrics

This is one of the major markets in Lagos for fabric lovers/tailors/designers/creatures in the clothing field and more!

There is almost no material you can't get here.
I came here for a velvet material.

What's important is that you are able to tell the difference between an original and a China. Cos most China looks like the original.

This place is still undergoing upgrade and construction.

The current state of this mall is sad 😭

This mall is slowly falling apart and it's increasingly evident that the mall is not being looked after properly 😕. When it rains, parts of the mall gets flooded and you see store owners trying to mop 🧹 away the water 💦 from their stores. Maybe that's why lots of stores are empty.

They also experience a lot of power outages without proper backup supply for power and let me not even get started on the ventilation 🌬️. They don't also have a good cooling system to keep the mall in good temperatures.

The mall is named after the street. It has ShopRite as it's anchor mall with a lot of others small Tennant. Most shoos are built withing the 20sqm...40sqm size so the mall are in quite a large numbers. The mall escalator is not functioning. The mall link the neighboring leisure mall from the inside with an indoor enclosed bridge Shoprite mall is fully stock with fair prices. Should be the biggest mall in surulere

Not a bad place for a stroll. Made a few friends here so its a place I like. Great for that evening after work to unwind eat and maybe see a movie.

Great selection of shops and stores too! From clothing to feeding to supermarkets gadgets and even perfumes and topping it all with a cinema. Really nice collection.

Not as busy as it once was so you'd probably enjoy it more now with all the space to move around.

Adenian ogunsanya shopping mall is one of the good mall in Surulere area.This is the oldest shopping mall in Surulere. Many shops are functioning here. The main attraction of this mall is ShopRite. Top of this mall there is wide food court. you can have food also you can play some games like snooker .KFC also functioning here. Many clothing shops like Ruff n Tumble, US polo etc are functioning here. Also Samsung authorised outlet is functioning too.
Mall needs renovation. A lot of stores didn’t have electricity, the escalator wasn’t working as well.

There are different shops for different things. You would find almost everything you can think of here. From household items to clothes to electronics, furnitures, foodstuff and lots more. The toilets are average, there is a normal section and a vip section, whichever you choose to use requires payment. There are parking spaces but you have to pay a fee to enter the market with your car. The market closes at 6pm sharp. After 6pm nobody would be allowed to enter, only those leaving. The products here are a little bit higher than your regular price but most of the goods here are of quality materials. Expect a little rowdiness in this area, afterall, it's a market. You can see products at wholesale prices and you can buy goods in bulk here. There are loads-carriers that help with goods for a negotiable fee. You get the lowest fee to some goods when you go deeper into the market shops. The space is very wide and has two entrance gates.

Massive market with many different sections: clothes, bags, shoes, food, electronics and many more. Security is top notch and the service is just as good. I highly recommend if you're looking for a place where you can shop without getting the normal experience of Nigerian markets. Although, some might say the items available here are a bit expensive

The Nigerian Army Shopping Complex is fast becoming one of my favourite markets or go to. Quite an organised place with almost all items you need to purchase being sold. A 9 always.  Love this place.

Shopping Arena Oshodi is one of the most complete and vibrant markets in Lagos. You can find almost anything here from electronics, foodstuffs, and clothes to cameras, male and female wears, inverters, and solar equipment. It’s a one-stop shopping center for all your needs.

The market is always bustling with people, so expect a bit of crowd and activity. Parking can be challenging because the car park fills up quickly, but it’s well organized, and no one blocks other vehicles.

The security presence in this market is also strong, giving shoppers peace of mind compared to many other markets in Lagos.

Overall, Shopping Arena Oshodi is a busy, safe, and well-organized market where you can get virtually everything you need at good prices.

I recently had the chance to visit an impressive shopping complex, a massive space where all kinds of shops are conveniently gathered under one roof. This place offers a seamless shopping experience with its spacious layout and ample parking facilities, making it an ideal destination for anyone looking to shop without the usual hassles of crowded streets or limited parking.

What struck me most was the sheer variety available. You can find virtually anything you’re looking for, whether it’s brand-new or second-hand items. From electronics to drapes, designer clothing to exquisite paintings, the options seemed endless. The best part? Bargaining is not only welcomed but encouraged, and with a little negotiation, you can walk away with some excellent deals that truly make the shopping experience worthwhile.

One of the highlights for me was discovering a collection of gorgeous curtains imported from Turkey. The material was of exceptional quality, and the intricate designs were absolutely stunning. It felt like owning a piece of art for your home. As an added convenience, they offer tailoring services right there on-site. All you have to do is provide your measurements, and in just a few hours, your custom curtains are ready to take home.

Overall, my visit to this shopping hub was a delightful experience. It’s a place where you can find great products, enjoy the thrill of bargaining, and even take advantage of services that make your purchases all the more special. I left feeling satisfied and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a one-stop shop with a wide range of quality products.

Prince Ebeano Supermarket in Ikeja is one of the most reliable and convenient places to shop in Lagos, especially if you prioritize variety, organization and easy shopping experience. One thing I genuinely appreciate about this location is how well stocked and consistent they are. Whether you are looking for imported food items, standard groceries, baby items, personal care, household essentials, drinks, spices, wines, cleaning materials or even small kitchen equipment, they always seem to have a good range available. It saves time compared to going to multiple stores because you can get almost everything you need in one place.

The store is clean, well arranged and easy to navigate. Their shelves are properly labelled, the aisles are wide enough, and it doesn’t feel chaotic like some supermarkets in Lagos. Another positive highlight is customer service — the attendants here are calm, helpful and more organized than many retail stores. Even during busy hours, they still manage the crowd with some structure.

Pricing is fair considering the location and the product range. Some items are slightly higher than regular neighborhood stores, but the convenience + availability makes it worth it. One thing I would love to see improved is more paypoint counters open during peak hours to reduce the queue delay especially in evenings and weekends.

Overall, Prince Ebeano Ikeja is a dependable shopping destination and I recommend it for general household shopping, restocking, monthly groceries and even emergency buys. It's one of the supermarkets in Lagos that actually understands structure and consistency.
