To my shock, one of the mall workers was telling her colleague that the lady must be mad 👹👹
I felt bad as I don't know what will be said behind me when I left too.
Anyway, I got the minced meat I needed but not the sausage beef.
The owner should train their staff on exceptional customer service experience

Okay I give them credit for having really affordable and kind of hard-to-find things that you sort of don't see in other stores that you probably have been looking for.

Mine was "blue magic" hair cream. God knows I have been looking for that hair cream everywhere and boom I saw it there just sitting pretty and affordable too not the ridiculous prices others inflate on their for profit. So yes it's a good spot to get your groceries

A convenience store to get anything from groceries, medications, beauty products, baked goods, raw food( meat fish fresh vegetables etc), soft drinks, alcoholic drinks, ice cream, stationeries, books just to name a few.
I personally shop here when am in the area

Its an okay store, the security guards should be the ones doing the cashier's job as they are more friendly and welcoming.
Prizes are relatively okay as well.

Neighborhood supermarket for a quick buy. They sell local and foreign packaged drinks and food items.

It's a small store so expect to be followed as you browse the store.

The environment is clean and the staff are average. The payment option is wide so you can make transfers here. The only con here is that you have to wait to obtain confirmation before you can leave with your goods.
The yogurt i bought yesterday was fresh, delicious, and reasonably priced. The staff was friendly, and the payment was quick. The store was clean and well-organized. I’ll definitely visit again.
Nice supermarket and cheap things are sold there, have been there several times with no complaints
Very very bad customer service, here’s a video of the staff attending and watching a video on her phone and not paying attention to her customers… so bad

This supermarket recently opened and it's got everything you need from groceries to toiletries and every other household item. The aisles are beautiful to look at and the staff are helpful and nice. You can pay with cash or card.

The parking lot is very big and spacious. There is a wheelchair accessible entrance and that is a big plus for inclusion. The prices are regular. I recommend this place.

Shopping experience was exciting. You're able to get a wide range of household consumables and utilities. Superb customer service from the staff as well. Lastly, easy to access location for residents along the route.

Ultra modern shopping complex with enough parking in space located at the busy subway of ago/okota, leading to isolo /cele roundabout from apple junction festac amuwo odofin Lagos.
A nice place to shop for your home essentials and grocery with good discounts,  The supermarket has nearly everything one needs for the home, kitchen and personal care and it offers a pleasurable shipping experience given the effective sir conditioning and helpful staff
I love their customer service. They have a wide range of products. The supermarket is quite big and spacious.

I've been passing by this supermarket without branching until I needed to buy something as early as 8am on a Sunday. That came in handy for me. The ambience and the layout is complimentary. The ample parking space.

Osata Supermarket was a shadow of it's old self when I visited. We used to shop for imported groceries and green teas from here in the early 2000s and the shelves are usually fully stocked. However, on my recent visit, I was met with empty shelves with few items on display.
They have very poor customer service. The owner's daughter and another woman who is more like their oldest staff can be very rude and disrespectful. Overall I will say it's a toxic place to buy.

I like that I can quickly get simple grocery items like shawarma bread, sweets, rice, sausages, shrimps, butter, cheese, freezer ice cream, coriander leaves, grapes etc without so much queue. They need to introduce fresh butchery.
Place is stacked as always.. but no one working there ever smiles. Like EVER!  You will find what you need there. Just don't expect the cashier to smile while your paying

Omg! I hadn't been into Osata in months. Going in there and seeing it looking almost empty. A new arrangement to cover the emptiness and the same unfriendly atmosphere will ensure I continue to stay away.

Mall mart at Herbert Macaulay is a a very good supermarket with everything when I say everything I mean everything. I do my low carb shopping there and by healthy seeds( chia, sunflower and flaxseed) the prices are okay.
But I have an issue with them on making customers pay tax on foreign products, like I don't understand it.

In general it's a very good place to shop.

A supermarket just discovered today. Low priced items truly but not all. Compared with others, it's on a par with some really low priced products. Nice set of items. First time searching for some categories was kind of uneasy but was finally understood eventually. Iced items within. Respectable staffs, very humble I must say. Good management. Seamless pay point. Wheelchair accessible entrance, accessible parking as well. Lots of products. Won gifts at a promo run by Milo. Good and conscious security. Attractive building as well.

Mallmart Hypermarket is a massive mall along Herbert Macaulay road just after Alagomeji

It's a one-stop shop you can get all your needs met in terms of food items, groceries, kitchen wares, electronics and other stuff

It's a large building that makes you go around each floor with enough space and also good parking space for your cars while you shop

The security guards from outside and inside the building are always available to assist you

They e got enough staff to attend to you while you do your shopping.

The payment system is also a good one without any ish

Go check them out

Mallmart Hypermarket along the Herbert Macually Way, Sabo...
A 3 storey building mall and all owned by the Company... Having a very spacious car lot and drive-ins ... Selling variety of Products and materials from consumables to home appliances like Electronics .. It's really an Hypermarket because it is house to lot of things.

Larger-than-average neighbourhood store. They have quite a variety of items. Skincare, drinks, dry goods, etc. They have a small produce section with vegetables and fruits, as well as frozen food items.

They have a stationery section and electronics section too. The staff there are usually very helpful too.

I see why they call this place the OG . My experience was a 10/10 primaryly because of the family / kid friendliness.  It was pretty easy to locate via Google Maps and we enjoyed every bit of our visit .

I had brunch  with my family and the ambience was nice , staff were courteous , it was truly money well spent .  my kids had a swel time while my husband and I were eating . They kids play area is definitely an attraction and kept the kids entertained the whole time we were there .

We had rice , taco’s, fruit juice and a strawberry milk shake . Total money spent was around 60,000 naira approximately. They definitely lived up to their hype and I’d definitely visit again .

Food was good, it came fast. Service was pleasant. Drinks were good and we could pay with an international card.
The scenery was very nice - a pool with good music.

Blu cabana is a very serene environment, its a nice place to relax with loved ones and family. There's a beautiful swimming pool area with a nice sit out and and indoor game area for children. The food was very tasty and delicious, we had fun. Great atmosphere, great services.

I recently visited Blu Cabana Restaurant & Café in Abuja, and it was such a relaxing experience from start to finish.

Ambience
The environment is calm, neat, and beautifully designed. Whether you sit indoors or by the poolside, the atmosphere feels peaceful and refreshing. It is ideal for lunch dates, casual meetings, or just unwinding after a busy day.

Food & Drinks
I had fried rice with chicken curry sauce, and it was absolutely delicious. The rice was perfectly seasoned, and the curry sauce had a rich, flavorful taste with tender pieces of chicken. The combination was well balanced and filling without being heavy. The presentation was clean and appetizing, and you could tell it was freshly prepared.

Service
The service was excellent. The staff were polite, attentive, and quick to respond. My food came out on time, and they made sure I had everything I needed throughout.

Overall Experience
Blu Cabana truly delivers on quality, comfort, and consistency. The ambience makes it easy to relax, the food is worth every bite, and the service ties everything together perfectly.

Would I recommend it? Absolutely!
It is one of those spots you will want to return to. Perfect for a chill outing, a romantic dinner, or just good food in a calm setting.

If you’re looking to spend a relaxing weekend in Abuja with a true resort vibe, there’s no better place than BluCabana! Access to the pool requires membership, but if you’re affiliated with a government organization or an NGO, you can use the pool for 7,000 Naira. The restaurant offers high-quality food at reasonable prices, and it’s especially perfect for larger groups who want to enjoy a lively atmosphere together.

I had my 19th(?) or so birthday here about a decade ago and that was my first time. Over the years, I’ve enjoyed this spot. During my last trip home, I went twice in a week with friends.
They’ve been able to maintain high standards: warmth, value, pricing and taste

I had my 19th(?) or so birthday here about a decade ago and that was my first time. Over the years, I’ve enjoyed this spot. During my last trip home, I went twice in a week with friends.
They’ve been able to maintain high standards: warmth, value, pricing and taste. 💓

I've been twice in 4 days. They say the portions are measured but the pounded yam is defo different each time.
Something about the food seems to turn my tummy a bit. Granted, i don't eat meat, so hygiene standards must be high anywhere in eat to avoid food contamination. I appreciate their food is typically ready in 25 minutes, so no long excessive waits. Staff are pleasant!

Very great and comfy place for a romantic meal. Music is soft, ambient light is warm and the food is heavenly. Everything is just perfect here. Food is not so pricey even...
The service is of very high standards and the food arrived quite fast. Minimal complains

I must say, I'm in love with the facility!!! I love the creative concept and setup. The service too is good and the facility is clean.

The meals took some time to deliver, but it was worth the wait. I had salad, shrimps, and fresh juice.

There was piano playing in the background, and it was just soothing. The lightning was balanced and sufficient. I just wished they also layered lights on the roof glass covering.

My overall experience was good this time.

Had a lovely time at Cantina Restaurant, Abuja. The ambience was good, the food was nice, but the real highlight was the service. Tina, our waitress, was so professional and attentive that I couldn’t help but wonder if the restaurant was named after her 😄😃 She truly made the experience memorable. Great food, great vibe, and top-notch service. Would definitely visit again!

By far my favorite dining venue in Abuja. It caters effortlessly to a wide range of guests—whether you’re in a meeting, need a quiet space to work, or want to enjoy a relaxed meal with friends. The menu is impressively diverse, featuring Mexican, Italian, Lebanese, Nigerian, and continental cuisine. There is also a thoughtfully curated wine selection, along with beers and cocktails. The management is exceptionally welcoming, and the service is consistently excellent.

Came to Cantina Restaurant to have their famous burger.

We ordered and waited 15 minutes and the server came back to say ZERO burgers, NONE

What a disappointment and what poor service - the kitchen could have told the servers that burgers were off the menu instead of making us wait for nothing

That plus the fact that they don't have cold drinks 👎

Can't give zero stars for service, so give 1 star
Food was great. Despite the place being really full, the service was exceptional and the food came quick.

Hands down one of the best restaurants I've been to in a long time. The food is excellent, so well cooked, I'm confident trying anything on the menu. The service is also great and the food comes out in good time. I highly recommend.

A very beautiful and cosy place to be in. The space is clean with good lighting. Was my second time there, still a good experience..

Peter attended to us, he was very polite and helpful with suggestions. We actually went for cocktails and mocktails but he ended up convincing us to have a little something by the side. We went for Calamari strips, truffle fries and Tar Tar special chicken
- I enjoyed every bit of the calamari strips, it was seasoned well.
- The truffle fries could’ve been better (the sauce could be separate next time)
-I wasn’t impressed by the special chicken (there was nothing special about it). Some of the chicken parts we were given had us wondering if it was bone we ordered. I think sticking to particular chicken parts would be better.

The cocktails and mocktail were a 10!!
Hidden treasure with nice wines.  Super chilled comfy sofa area outside which was not hot at all

Had dinner with my friends and the food was yummy.
Lovely ambience, low lights beautiful entrance and great customer service.

We celebrated a birthday party and the nice staff came out to sing for the celebrant. The atmosphere was great and the ambience was the most beautiful thing. Their outdoor seating has a bit of a mosquito issue when it gets late though.

This is a beautiful place. Starting from the warm handkerchief to clean my palm and the cool atmosphere.
Not hot not cold just cool I will say this the number one restaurant in Abuja for me.
The staffs are supper helpfully from the entrance to exit.
You won’t know places like this exist cuse it’s in a hidden area but it’s a beautiful to explore

Overall a poor experince. The Asian rice was 2/3 rds cabbage and 1/3rd rice. It was dissapointing. The Suya was tasty but not worth the price. The half chicken was really 1/4th chicken. It had no real taste and was dry but the texture was good. It came with some complimentary garlic bread(?) which was quite tasty. The ceasar salad was not really a ceaser salad but more of what they think a ceaser salad might be. It had no lettuce, no croutons or ceaser dressing or anything that involves making a ceasar salad, although it did have onions... We chose to eat outside which was a bad choice because of the flies which nearly spoiled our already dissapointing food. When we told someone, the answer we got was "sorry." The upper-outside level we stayed on did have a nice view of the surrounding area, but that is about it. Me and my wife were very dissapointed with the overall experience for the price we paid.

Any restaurant where they serve free starters (hot puff-puff in this case) while you wait for your meal always wins my heart😉😝
Okay! I loved it here....
The ambience, the staffs, the food and service was excellent.
Speaking of the food, preparation didn't take long, the plating was neat and it will make your mouth watery. I enjoyed every bit of my food so did my companions.

I'll recommend.

The only problem here is, the parking space is small.

This restaurant is a really nice place to be. Beautiful and clean with amazing staff that respond to you diligently.
My food didn’t take up to ten minutes before it arrived despite having to attend to other customers.
Now let’s talk about the food! Mmmm 😋 my favorite part. I really enjoyed the food and it was just the right portion of food.
Serving mouth watering dishes alongside beautiful ambience is the deal and they hit the right spot, so I’ll recommend 💯
Officially my favorite after being to some other restaurant, they never disappoint❤️

Enjoyed the penne alfredo dish. Cocktails were strong and quite tasty. However, the waiter forgot one of our orders and therefore made us wait for more than 30 minutes for it. We eventually had it packed as we couldn’t sit and eat it at the restaurant. Overall, lovely atmosphere and good food

Not easy to locate.
Very limited parking space, had to repark during dining.
Small dining space.
Food and drinks were average.
The waitress was very attentive and showed concern when we didn’t eat much of the food we ordered.
Pricing was ok.

Very good restaurant, Libanese style, in the middle of the city that offers inside and outside seat capacity. I had a very comfortable visit with a great dish. I took a mixed grill BBQ style. The meat was very good and plenty enough. The service is excellent, all of the time a waiter is available to help in a very polite way. Worth the visit!
The food was fire 🔥 🔥 will definitely visit again. The portions are sizeable, tasty and pocket friendly. First time I tasted hummus 😋 so delicious I loved it. And the bread soft and hot!

This place is great. Just around the corner from Prince Ebeano, City View is a simple and really nice Lebanese restaurant. Pleasant, helpful service, big menu, good prices. Dine in or eat out. They always get it right.
Food is super amazing, good outdoor tubular area and indoor, parking is not that large, people are so friendly. Strongly recommend

Lovely environment. We ate in the garden area and it had just rained so the air felt really clean and fresh. The food was  served very timely. Food was freshly made, middle eastern Mediterranean flavours. Well prepared and tasty. The platting was also great and we got complementary salads from the chef.
The prices are very fair in comparison to the quality and quantity of the meal.
Kudos to the staff who were very attentive and kind especially when they saw I had a medical cast on my leg and they made sure I was very comfortable. They were also kind enough to help take pictures of me and my friend.
Generally money well spent and worth it. I had a great lunch experience.

We went for a Dinner of 50 people, we were the organizers. We used indoors. The management was very considerate and helpful,  we got very good bargain for that number.
The food was great, the services was good, more than 5 waiters were assigned to us. They provided sound equipment at our request. They even have a standby photographer if you need one.

Consistently great food and service! Cilantro never disappoints — the food is always fresh and delicious, and the staff are warm and attentive. The ambience is lovely and serene; I especially enjoy watching the monkeys in the trees while dining outdoors. It’s very family-friendly, with both indoor and outdoor seating options that are beautifully set up. Perfect for date nights, birthday gatherings, or just a relaxed meal out. One of my favorite spots in town!

I didn’t get a chance to capture the environment because I was busy with work, but I ordered the naan and butter chicken curry for take-out and really enjoyed it. There’s also lots of space and convenient parking, which is a big plus.

I had the pleasant surprise of discovering Cilantro during my trip to Abuja. The place is absolutely charming, surrounded by trees, beautifully maintained, and with a truly lovely atmosphere.

From the very first moment, I was warmly welcomed. The staff are incredibly friendly and attentive, always ready to assist with a smile.

The food is simply amazing, with genuinely authentic Indian flavours. It felt like tasting a piece of India in Nigeria, an authentic and delicious experience!

Another major highlight is that they accept international cards, which is quite rare in Abuja and makes a real difference for travellers.

I’d also like to give a special mention to the manager, Ram, who was outstanding, a kind, dedicated professional who went above and beyond to ensure we had the best possible experience.

I will definitely be returning, and I highly recommend it!

Cilantro, Abuja (Maitama)
We visited Cilantro near Maitama—an Indian-style restaurant with plenty of space and nice surroundings. The food was okay, though on the pricier side, and overall it felt a bit costly for what was offered. The ambiance and setting were pleasant, but the value for money could have been better.

An ideal place for solo dates, group dates, or any type of get-together. It's spacious, with a great ambiance, beautiful minimalist designs, quality customer service, and really delicious food. The restroom is quite small, but very clean. It's truly an A-Class restaurant.

My experience was wonderful! The atmosphere was ambient, subtle music played and added a calming effect to the place. Their prices are affordable and their meals are delicious — it's also notable that they don't waste time with orders and the wait staff are equally efficient.

I highly recommend for birthdays, solo dates, any type of celebration and get-together!

I was really impressed with the service here. The waitress was very pleasant and she had a sound knowledge of everything on the menu, she could answer almost every question we asked.
⁣⁣⁣⁣
I enjoyed everything we had, the combo starter most especially. The beef fried noodles wasn’t what I expected though because it didn’t look like what was posted on their page but it tasted good.

It’s a nice place to have a family lunch/dinner. They also have an outdoor space but I preferred sitting inside. I wouldn’t mind trying out other meals here. ⁣⁣

The food  was a great quality, like the presentation of the food as well as the taste of it. It was indeed A Class.

The environment has a play where children could play.

I really wish they can up their game on providing customer with more hygienic conditions, precisely washing of hands. We had to walk a long walk to wash our hands by the toilet or a sink outside it which we had to use the soap by a mop stand... it think that was unhygienic .  It will be for them to have a washing sink by one at the outdoor area and one inside.

Also, it will be good to also provide for some electric insect repellent.

Customer service is really not a catch thing as well. Whereas I can't tell much as that may be a combination of other unknown factors... I think as a first time user, the waitress/ waiter would need to be educated on how to improve their clientele management.

Overall is a good place to go... I forgot to mention that their portion is as big as it tells on the pocket and presentation. If you are a shallow water be ready to share your portion

This is a good restaurant. The location is ideal and the infrastructure is nice and classy. The interior is beautiful, clean and seems well-maintained. The waitress who attended to me was very polite.
The restrooms are quite clean and the food tastes nice. It's quite expensive, but there are restaurants for every budget scale in Abuja

This restaurant has a great location inside Novare Central Mall and an interior that’s honestly top-tier — modern, stylish, and perfect for photos. The atmosphere is definitely part of the appeal.

That said, the food doesn’t really live up to the hype. The dishes look nice but the taste is underwhelming, especially for the price. It feels unnecessarily expensive for what you actually get.

Overall, The Vue delivers on setting and ambience, but falls short on flavour and value. Solid spot to hang out, just not the best place if you care most about the food.

I came here to celebrate a friend's birthday, and this place is absolutely gorgeous. Everything about the place is beautiful, the service was very good, and the waiters were nice and respectful.  Honestly, the food was pretty okay, nothing too crazy. Except for the naan bread, the naan bread was absolutely divine. I would highly recommend anyone to try it if they go there.

Limited choices and their wine is based on what’s available. I will recommend for service and aesthetics because if has an amazing view and is really spacious. I was in the indoor but the outdoor looked nice. My meal was ok but my date couldn’t eat hers. If your pallets aren’t wired for Asian dishes wouldn’t recommend but all in All a good experience

Ordered Lamb Biryani and was served with lamb fried for soup mixed in rice.  Could not have more than one mutton piece.  Avoid if looking at Indian Cuisine.  Really bad and all they had to say was we will do better next time!!!

𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐧𝐯𝐢𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭
Open bright space dinning area and a cool outdoor spot. The indoor great for dining with crowd, birthdays and celebrations cause of its open space & large dining areas. The outdoor great for a chilled evening

Ambience is cool and quiet especially when not full to capacity. Despite the song played in the restaurant you can still have a good conversation without screaming.

𝐜𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐫 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐜𝐞
Courteous staff from entrance to exit and readily available to take your order, request or complains. The Manager was onsite too which showed great attention to customers needs.

𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐞𝐬
Prices of food (appetizer/main dish) are moderate ranges from N3000-4500).

𝐟𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐝𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐤𝐬
Very delicious, one of my best tasted meals. Definitely try “hot garlic jumbo prawns”  Prides in Indian & Chinese dishes mostly. Portion sizes are big enough to share and taste really good too. However didn’t try their cocktails/mock tails so not certain of the taste.

𝐦𝐲 𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞
Overall I loved it and will definitely visit again and again.

We popped in for a late lunch, the area is quiet. The cave decor makes the place a welcome respite from the super bright and hot street. The staff are polite and attentive. The food took about 15 mins to arrive but drinks came out quite quickly. The food is well done, I love that they don't automatically have pepper in their food (easy for those who don't eat pepper) but the food is well seasoned nonetheless. I would recommend for that special event and quiet intimate lunch or dinner.

I absolutely love this restaurant and creativity that comes with it!

The Interior
The cave-styled architectural design is nothing short of enchanting. It must have required a great deal of creativity to make a beautiful concept out of this, and they executed it perfectly. The setting gives you the delightful illusion of actually sitting inside a cave.

The Service
Right from the entrance, I was impressed. The security at the gate was so chivalrous- he opened the car door for me and closed it gently after we stepped out. Inside, the attendants, with a warm smile opened the door ajar to welcome us in.
Vivian was our beautiful waitress for the afternoon. She was smart, neat in appearance, well-spoken and articulate, as well as super attentive.  She ensured we were comfortable throughout our stay and even offered to take our photographs before and during our dining experience.

The Food
For starters, we had calamari bites. Our main course included char grilled roasted chicken and "The Cave" (dirty rice). For dessert, we enjoyed apple blueberry cake and cheesecake. Every dish without any exception was absolutely delicious - rich in flavour and aesthetically presented.

The Environment
There was ample parking space for vehicle owners. This made arriving and settling in hassle-free.

Ambience & Music
I loved the hanging lanterns and the solemn, serene atmosphere. However, I did notice that the air conditioning wasn't quite sufficient for the size of the space - something the Management might wanna address. The choice of music could also be better; a more soulful R&B playlist would compliment the relaxed vibe of the restaurant perfectly.

Final Impression
It was my first time visiting a restaurant that requests guests to fill out a feedback form after their meal. I see this as a thoughtful gesture that shows they truly care about improving their service. It was overall a wonderful experience and I cannot wait to return!

I loved the food. It was really good, although it came out a little late and wasn’t served as piping hot as you’d expect. The naan bread was absolutely delicious. We also enjoyed the drinks.

The music selection that day wasn’t great, and it was quite loud, but when we asked them to tune it down, they adjusted it and switched to a better playlist, which improved the ambience.

I went with my friends, and it’s a really nice, cool place to entertain friends or just sit and enjoy a meal together. The staff were very polite, the ambience was good, and overall we had a great experience.

Kapadoccia was amazing!
The Linguine was perfection, the shrimp and calamari were super fresh and the sauce was just incredible. The Midnight Goblet was a dream: blueberry, blackberry, grape, mint, and lemon all layered into this gorgeous, refreshing drink. Everything was just so good, always a pleasure being there.

I will say this was a perfect experience. This is probably one of the best restaurants you could visit in Abuja. Locating the place was very easy. The security at the entrance were very courteous and helpful. They helped with parking, even opened the door for me. The ambience inside was on point. It was so beautiful and cool. The music was not too loud, just perfect. The temperature was well regulated
The waiter was on his A-game.
The drinks were freshly made and came out really nicely.
The appetiser was really nice, although I will say I've had nice calamari.
The platter was perfect. I love the way it was served.
The dessert also did not disappoint.
As for the bill, I think it's fair, considering all that was put into this place. But if you are looking for somewhere cheap, this is not for you.
Overall, it was a lovely experience, worth repeating

Gusto is proof that sometimes you really do have to give places a second chance. My first visit was on a bustling Saturday night in the outdoor space, and I left pretty underwhelmed. The only thing I distinctly remember enjoying was the music.

Fast forward a few years later, a Monday afternoon lunch date with a girlfriend, after our first and second choices were both closed, and Gusto ended up being the closest option. I’m so glad I didn’t immediately shut it down. The indoor ambiance felt upscale and spacious, much more refined than my first experience. That said, coming in from the hot outdoors, it could definitely have been a lot cooler inside.

The service was attentive and pleasant, and the food was actually quite tasty this time around, though the portions were on the smaller side. Overall, a much better experience than my first visit and a reminder that timing (and seating choice) can really shape your impression of a place.

We celebrated our anniversary at Gusto Abuja. There grilled prawns are amazing and every time we go we order the same thing.  But keep changing the starters and the desserts. Good service and helpful staff. Prices are pretty steep.

Really nice place, good atmosphere with nice music.

Went for open sushi night, was really delicious. 50k for all you can eat sushi.

Will come again for sure with friends.

Edit : went twice with my friend, still amazing

Gusto delivered a truly elevated dining experience. From the chic atmosphere to the attentive service, everything felt thoughtfully curated. Most dishes were a hit: the sushi was fresh and flavorful (though I wish the rolls were a little more bite-sized), and the cocktail was tasty.

The only note is that the veggie rice could’ve used a touch more finesse. The vegetables were slightly undercooked. Overall, the experience was elegant and relaxed and worth revisiting. I’ll be back.

We had a sushi party yesterday with my group of friends (around 9 people). The service accommodates your wishes and stays professional. The food is high quality and comes fast out of the kitchen. Thank you again to Gusto team for this wonderful evening ! See you soon hopefully !
Love the experience. The ambience is very nice. The customer service was top notch. Had a lovely time with my family on our anniversary. The music, the lighting, the food presentation was great.

Uncle T’s has a beautiful, aesthetic ambiance and a fun, lively vibe, perfect for a family outing or a casual night out. The service was solid and the drinks were yummy, but unfortunately, the food left much to be desired. The prawns didn’t taste fresh, and while the meals weren’t outright bad, they lacked the flavor and punch I was hoping for.

That said, the highlight for me was hands-down the dessert, absolutely delicious! I’d recommend Uncle T’s more as a spot for dessert and drinks rather than a full meal. It’s a lovely space with good energy, just come with adjusted expectations when it comes to the food.

Uncle T’s has the best staff, best meals, and a variety to choose from.
There’s more than enough seating; outdoors, terrace, and indoors.
If you’re in Abuja and looking for a classic place to dine, Uncle T’s is the place!

I ordered the ambassador steak and it tasted weird and oddly had a sweet undertone to it. I wish they’d had just used salt and pepper to base it.

Also ordered their evening special drink which tasted not great. Was bitter and tasted a bit like a medicine.

The tea here was 10/10 would come back for the tea and service but definitely not the food

The restaurant is incredibly spacious, offering both indoor and outdoor seating options. The restaurant has lovely neon phrases on the walls and the place is beautiful. The music is always a hit.
The owners of the restaurant are very kind and they're always around and so are the managers. The staff is very respectful and attentive and always ready to take your order or bring you anything you need. I've tried nearly every item on the menu, and I've loved every single meal. Make sure you go and try EVERYTHING in that place (food AND drinks)

The food was so good! We went as a group of 10 and shared 2 platters. The only thing is that the food took so long to arrive. But the ambience is really nice, very cozy and warm with friendly staff too.
We also got a visit from the resident monkey! He was quite entertaining.

When I got here I received a warm welcome from the waitress by the door and she led me in to offer me a table. There weren’t many people here probably because it’s weekday but the atmosphere was nice and I like the forest idea of decoration. There wasn’t much on the menu as the drink section has more options than the food/dessert section. The food section of the menu was categorized as “Lunch” so at first I thought there’d be a “Dinner” category however there was none. The waitress recommended the Thai Fried Rice and I honestly enjoyed it! I got the Palo Marita Mocktail which had this sharp sweet taste but was really nice too. We also got the Grilled Chicken Avocado Salad and that was equally tasty.

Nice ambience. Enjoyed the Thai Fried rice. Prompt service. The flowing water wasn't working this time (they said it needs repairs). Chairs close to the walls were too low (relative to the table), I had to sit up and lean forward. Had afrobeat music on at a decent volume.

Overall, it's a good place.

Tip:
Check out the upstairs section if you want some more privacy.

We were greeted when we walked in and seated in an area of our choice. We came in the middle of the day, and it wasn’t crowded. The atmosphere definitely gives Amazon forest vibes, complete with vines, rain sounds and an elephant sculpture in the back of the room. The menu is very diverse. I ordered a mocktail and the Tuscan pasta. It was so good! The portion sizes are nice and I personally had enough to take home. My husband ordered tacos and a cocktail, he enjoyed his meal as well. I really enjoyed my experience here. Especially Mr. Gorilla that came out to say hi. Lol 🙂

I had my birthday dinner here. It was a lovely experience. The staff really made it all super comfortable. And the meals we got, were great. The atmosphere has forest feel with the water running, and the gorilla costume guy who made us laugh.

Lovely place in a strategic location. Map is accurate. Food is the really nice and prices are fair.

I was particularly impressed that they kept to time for a reservation, food was ready at the time we gave them.

The staff are very courteous and swift.
Great tasting cocktails also.

It was an amazing experience! The food was delicious and they prepared it quickly which I appreciated cause I had an hour of my break and needed to eat and get back within that timeframe.

The ambience of the restaurant was beautiful and a bit private. The prices were affordable even with the price hike, and the service was exceptional! I highly recommend visiting the Charcoal Grill!

This review is for Ms. Ogechi. When a customer explains to you that their food has been overcooked, you don’t insinuate that they’re lying. You try to resolve the issue. That’s how customer service works. Did you pay for the lamb? Did you taste the lamb? The fair skinned man was very polite and very respectful. That’s customer service. This review isn’t so much to fault the entire restaurant as it is to hold the restaurant accountable for employees having a terrible attitude when it comes to customer service. As a customer, you can choose to spend your money at any restaurant, you don’t have to choose this particular one. But at least the employee who is supposed to be serving you should communicate the appreciation from the restaurant by serving you with respect.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ A Hidden Gem!

Charcoal restaurant is a place to visit !impressed! The food was absolutely delicious – every dish was full of flavor, beautifully presented, and clearly made with care. You can really taste the quality in every bite.

The hygiene standards are top-notch, which is something I always look out for, and the entire place was spotless. It’s clear they take cleanliness and customer safety seriously.

Service was another highlight – the staff were friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience feel welcoming and relaxed.

Highly recommend if you’re looking for a great meal in a clean and cozy setting. Can’t wait to come back

Read some good reviews and so decided to try it out. Ordered the chef salad which was supposed to come with feta cheese but Not! It was subbed with shredded mozzarella and between the waiter and the chef, not one thought to inform the guest that there was no Feta cheese.

Next was the spring rolls...well let's say the local version as there was nothing springy about it. Texture was "doughy" and sweet as opposed to being flaky (filo dough) and with a springy crunch on the bite. Well suffice to say I returned the  chef salad and paid for the rolls and my drink.

I'm sure they do some things well but on this  first visit here I'm disappointed. Will see what happens next try.

Recommend though but "grill" the waiter and chef about your order. Pun intended.

place_name: Ancient Flavours continental restaurant and Grill (Best restaurant in Abuja)
review_text:
Ancient Flavours was a genuinely enjoyable experience. The menu is pretty solid, now, it’s not gourmand dining, but it’s honestly doing much better than many places that loudly advertise themselves as such. The food was flavourful, delicious, and served in generous portions, which I always appreciate.

The ambiance is clean, bright, and spacious, with both indoor and outdoor seating options that make it feel comfortable and versatile. We had the lamb chops with mashed potatoes, the mash could’ve been softer and creamier, and the lamb could’ve been juicier (I forgot to specify my preferred doneness, and I wasn’t asked), but overall it was still tasty and well-seasoned.

We also tried the spicy chicken wings, crispy wings, and a burger, all of which were satisfying and well-executed. Service was good and attentive, though I did visit during the week at a relatively quiet time, which likely helped.

All in all, Ancient Flavours delivers solid, flavourful food in a pleasant setting. Definitely a reliable and enjoyable spot.

place_name: Ancient Flavours continental restaurant and Grill (Best restaurant in Abuja)
review_text: A quiet place. I almost missed it because a tree is blocking the yellow sign on the side of the wall.  The food is great. It did not take long to come out. Portions are huge, big enough to share or 2 meals for one person. They make orders to your liking, (if you don't like pepper), I would recommend for meetings or just hanging out with friends. The non-alcoholic drinks section is a bit limited but I enjoyed the fresh orange juice. The staff were a bit unsure about various things but it could be they are new? They were otherwise polite and attentive.

place_name: Ancient Flavours continental restaurant and Grill (Best restaurant in Abuja)
review_text: Went for my dad’s birthday dinner. Ordered the salmon&veggies from the fish menu (can’t remember the exact dish), also ordered the chicken oriental. Absolutely amazing experience. The staff was very courteous and they adhere to very high standards as it pertains to food safety and hygiene. The food options are numerous, extremely amazing and awesome. The food also tasted great and the food presentation was worthy of an award.

place_name: Ancient Flavours continental restaurant and Grill (Best restaurant in Abuja)
review_text:
The food and ambience here is so good,the chef really makes tasty meals..
Breakfast lovers would find here fascinating as they have varieties of breakie options.
You could also use here as a quick workstation because it’s absolutely serene and calm.
Pictures and videos won’t really do you any good…You need to visit here and relieve your own wonderful experience.

place_name: Ancient Flavours continental restaurant and Grill (Best restaurant in Abuja)
review_text: This is my go-to place for days I feel like hanging out and not trying a new place, cos I know I'd have a good meal. Nice ambience, great food. I recommend their pineapple fried rice as its really good. Its also a great place for family dinners, proposals and dates. Their lamb shank can be better but great place as a whole.

It's a decent restaurant with decent services. Their food is great compared to other restaurants and you'll find good customer services.

I highly recommend. A 4-star because while I was cool with it, I wasn't necessarily impressed with the restaurant as a whole.

A restaurant with a wonderful atmosphere, perfect for catching up with friends or spending quality time with a partner. The waiters are kind and attentive, and the service is excellent. I tried the Chicken Alfredo, and the creamy sauce paired perfectly with the rice—it was absolutely delicious.

Located in the heart of Wuse 2, opposite Peniel apartments, this restaurant serves a mix of local and continental dishes. It has a lovely ambience, clean and quiet. The meals tasted really good and the portions are large. I enjoyed the peppered chicken wings, the milkshake was lovely too. It’s a child friendly environment with lots of parking space. Overall, it’s a lovely restaurant to spend time with family and friends.

Cosy environment.
The meals are delicious, plated and presented nicely.
Friendly and courteous staff.

A nice and quiet place to sit with friends and have a discussion over a meal without shouting to be heard.

The price is fair.

I had a very casual dinner here on my birthday,the staffs were extremely nice and lively they made my night.
However,the meals were not as tasty as they used to be before we barely finished our meal because it wasn’t really giving..
I remember always running back here to have my favorite pasta and all but tbh I was a lil bit disappointed
Don’t know how that can be resolved?
I love the collections of music they play here really nice and calm selection,I recommend here for people looking to have a wonderful evening with a lil view especially when you sit outside.
Thanks to your extremely friendly staffs for making my day.

I ordered the pan fried steak. Plating was mid, for just the steak. We ordered burgers and pizzas and they came out looking good. The food was quite good, my brother said the Julius burger was the best one he'd had. Ambience was really good, I enjoyed the music and the conversations with family. It did help that there was gym right there with eye candy 😂😂. I'd recommend it, 100% but maybe not the steak 😂
Nice social club located within life camp. Has good size pool but it was being cleaned when I visited.
The food is good though it’s always a challenge requesting for baked/grilled sweet potatoes. I wonder why.  The service is good too.

I ordered the pan fried steak. Plating was mid, for just the steak. Fam ordered burgers and pizzas and they came out looking good. The food was quite good, my brother said the Julius burger was the best one he'd had. Ambience was really good, I enjoyed the music and the conversations with family. It did help that there was gym right there with eye candy 😂😂. I'd recommend it, 100% but maybe not the steak 😂.

Clubhouse Restaurant & Gym is an awesome place of relaxation within the heart of LifeCamp. It's serene and secure location adds to the allure of this place. With it's Standard Gym and Swimming pool, Clubhouse Restaurant &Gym boasts of an appreciable class of clientele.

Among my favourite drinks is their Virgin Mojhito and its cocktail version. Also, they have the most amazing 🍔 ever!

Do you want a quiet and classy evening hangout with business associates, friends or even a romantic outing with that favourite somebody?

Do you wanna shed some weight, stay fit or network with gym buddies?

Or perhaps  you just want to have a cool dip after a hot sweaty day?

I recommend Clubhouse Restaurant & Gym.

Breeze Restaurant is such a lovely spot to unwind! The atmosphere is serene, calm, and beautifully set up — perfect for a relaxed hangout. I visited on a Saturday and was pleasantly surprised to find entertainment on offer. Although the activities were a bit limited, they added a nice touch to the overall experience. The service was warm and attentive, and the food? Absolutely delicious — every bite was a win!

We ordered some drinks and some food, the drinks were great but it took over an hour for the food to come out and it took a lot for someone to come over to get our bill and then when we finally did get to pay, the first attempt at the pos failed and they wanted us to transfer to a persons account which was not the company’s account. This is really disappointing as I have experienced this here in the past and had stopped coming because of its We tried the pos for the second time and it worked and it we didn’t have to pay her, she says “Catherine” is the owners account but I highly doubt that.

She’s the cashier and had a pink dress on tonight. Please find details of the personal account provided us below and details of our receipt thank you.

My experience at Breeze Restaurant was mixed. I had some things I loved and some other things that just outright frustrated me.

I ordered the special rice but I asked for the prawns to be swapped for chicken. The portion was a bit small but it tasted really good. From my experience, there’s always a tendency to over spice “Special Rice” cos you want to make it special but this was seasoned very well and the chicken tasted great! My favorite thing was that drink; I can’t remember the name but it had ginger, pineapple and some other things. It’s weird because it had a confusing after taste but I still kept drinking it (and I was actually enjoying it). 😂

The main negative for me was the service. A group of waiters (5+) were gisting when we walked in and we sat for over 15 minutes and not a single person came to us. I literally had to call out to them 😪. Aside from that, the two people that answered us were very nice, and patient. Although, they didn’t know much about the menu. Another issue for me was that cheesesteak sandwich - the bread was hard (I think they grilled it for too long) and it was very difficult to eat.

Overall, it wasn’t a bad experience at all just a few things that need to be resolved.

I felt I found my new favorite spot after spending just 5 minutes. The place is cool, calm, beautiful and beautiful. I know I said “beautiful” twice. They really didn’t do so much but the place looks so beautiful. The attendants are smart, fast, friendly, active and just sweet…they were all smiles, gave feedbacks, did a lot to make us not feel the delay of our food. We had grilled fish and it was nice, didn’t exactly like my drink and I was trying it for the first time. My best part was the music, I love good music and the DJ won my heart…he played the right songs and places them so well. The only thing I didn’t like was the size of the bathroom 🙈 not a big deal tho just my thing.
It’s a really nice place to just unwind and it’s affordable too.

So I'm really excited about this place.
It is sparkling, clean, well laid out, artistic and just generally classy in terms of services available, furnishing, staff (dressing and behaviour), and location. You are greeted on arrival by smiling waiters. Nice.
Despite its location, in the centre of the ever busy Wuse 2 axis, it has a fairly large pool (8 feet at deepest end) and the seating areas are spaced out. The parking space outside is small for the kind of crowd a beautiful place like that will definitely attract, but large enough for the typical Abuja restaurant setting.
They have a nice looking bar with wide selection of drinks, several private and open seating areas, poolside seating, a outdoor grill area and lots more.
My only grouse is that the pool closes by 6pm. Kinda early for me.

Update: after my 3rd visit, I can confirm that the food is pricier than it tastes and the ambience, rather than the food, is what will take me back.
Superb experience! Great culinary. Get ready to habee all your meals in jumbo size! Fantastic indoor games too complement your experience as well. Good for family and group outings.

I enjoyed the food, service and ambience. Especially the entertainment. It was a Saturday night, they had really energetic dancers.
The food was generous. That’s one portion of nkwobi in 2 bowls🤯.
It was very tasty too. I enjoyed my evening here.

One of my favorite places! Thursday nights are karaoke nights, and the atmosphere is always lively and fun. The staff are friendly, the menu is diverse with plenty of delicious options, and the vibe of the restaurant is stylish yet welcoming. I also feel the crowd here is really nice, which makes the whole experience even better.
Lovely place to relax and chill pricing is also fair I'd visit again for sure.

Crush Cafe was fun. It was packed, loud, bustling, and energetic. There were dancers and Goldberg had a raffle draw event where people won food items. It was my first time there and I was surprised at how big the place was. Different things going on at different points. There were local games, dancers, bar, a bakery I think, indoor lounge, outdoor, etc. it all worked cohesively, it was well put together.

Our food took a long while to come but we couldn't complain much because our waitress Deborah was cheerful and helpful. The food needs improvement but not bad. Loud music, lights, action.

Jabi Lake Mall is a great place to shop, dine & relax in Abuja. Clean, family-friendly environment with a good mix of stores, eateries and entertainment like the cinema. The lake view adds a lovely atmosphere. Parking is easy, and staff are generally helpful. A must-visit spot in the city!

It’s a shopping mall that hosts a wide variety of stores. You’ll find an iPhone store, ShopRite, numerous clothing boutiques, several fashion brand outlets, perfume shops, and even Skechers for footwear. There are also make-up stores, restaurants like Ocean Basket, a furniture store, and many others. The mall is beautiful, very clean, and well maintained.

Jabi Lake Mall is an excellent destination for shopping and dining. Beyond the wide variety of restaurants and great shopping options, the location on Jabi Lake offers beautiful scenery, especially at night. Parking and security are good. You can even go for boat rides on the lake, making it a highly recommended spot.
Nice looking mall, great place to walk around and shop. Lots of stores to visit and window shop at too.

Jabi lake Mall has different shops/brands, on this visit to the mall I shopped at "The Body Shop" now if you don't know this brand, let me invite you to try it, JUST TEST and see that the LORD is good! 🤣 Only God can inspire the kind of ethical and vegan products The Body Shop makes. It's a British brand, not too pricey and my skin has improved drastically after one week use of their products. They are in Abuja and Lagos, Oh and the Staff at Their Jabi Lake Mall outlet, beautiful people!

Novare Gateway Mall is a two-phase shopping mall development located close to Lugbe, along Airport Road in Abuja. The first phase of this development by Novare Equity Partners delivered 15,000sqm of retail space in 2017 with a range of tenants including Shoprite, Fun World, Pep, Genesis Deluxe Cinemas etc. The second phase will add another 10,000sqm to the mall, however, a timeline for this addition has not been indicated. The Mall is a major shopping & entertainment destination located close to Lugbe, along the Umaru Yar'adua Expressway, popularly known as Airport Road, Abuja, Nigeria. It is a magnificent edifice that one can not miss along this super highway. The mall features a wide variety of shops, restaurants, leisure activities & businesses with Shoprite obviously as its main dweller. It officially opened on October 15, 2004 with Araneta City, Inc as the developer & providing the management as well. The mall offers a comprehensive range of shopping options, with the key stores & services ranging from groceries to electronics, furniture, fashion, food etc. The foremost grocer or business here is Shoprite, which is a household name/brand in the country. Unfortunately, the  Shoprite Mall here has been shut for sometime now due to 'technical reasons'. Hope & pray they overcome whatever issues & bounce back ASAP. For fashion & accessories you have super stores like Skechers, Essenza, Ruff n Tumble, & Timekeepers International Abuja, which offers luxury watches & jewelry amongst many others. Coming to technology & electronics, the options include Scanfrost & Royalline Technologies amongst others. Health & Beauty plus Pharmacies are not left out with brand names like Medplus Pharmacy & Nett Pharmacy available, as well as beauty multiple fragrance outlets. In respect of home & homeware, super stores like Baffi Furniture and Miniso are here. Dining & entertainment are also prominent here with a food court & a variety of dining and entertainment options for all ages & classes. Restaurants & eateries present range from fast food to conventional dining. Brands like Domino's Pizza, Cold Stone Creamery, Burger King, Krispy Kreme, The Food Factory are all rooted here. Coming to entertainment, the mall includes Nova Cinema (formerly Genesis Deluxe Cinemas) for movies and a wonderful  Fun World arcade/game center for kids & gaming buffs. It also has 250 square metres of office space. The choice of location in the densely populated Lugbe District is a critical strategic consideration by the developers of this project. Thus, the mall’s location along the main 10-lane highway between Abuja’s Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport and the city’s central business district means the mall will be one of the first structures travellers will see on their journey to or from the airport. The car parking area is massive, well tarred, demarcated, marked & virtually inexhaustible. There is even a highend car wash by the parking area. The management of this facility is apparently highly efficient. Everywhere (inside & out) is sparkling clean. Cleaners could be seen actively cleaning, mopping, sweeping, brushing & shinning round the clock. The convenience here is world class in terms of design, layout, sanitation etc. Uniformed private security staff are also ubiquitous around the grounds. However, the downside of the security staff is that they are fond of soliciting for cash handouts & tips. This could be amusing & irritating at different times due to the manners of approach. Sign of the times I guess. However, I praise the magnificence, structure & management of this imposing mall & it's operations
I had lots of fun, beautiful environment with warm welcoming security. Good parking space and lots of games to play. It's a good place for a family hangout.

Omg!!! It's a beautiful place to be. It's an embodiment of wonderful mindset. It's a Mall where you go shopping for everything you can want. Before we even think of buying anything, my kiddos and I first had a good walk around the Mall to feed our eyes with the beauty that is contained there in. It's a kid-friendly environment and places where families can relax and catch fun. Very large and organized free-parking lots. You are accorded with respect from the gate to the securities within the hall. Oh, I love that place.
It's a place to be. The presence of a cinema within the Mall, makes it classical.

There is lots of place to have a good time with my boys. We fun in Fun World than had ice cream sometimes we are eating pizza also. We shopped in miniso and shoprite supermarket. Also i saw wonderful furnitures in Baffi and you may have clothes from pep. In short you may have a wonderful time with your family. Even there is a cinema. Actually as a Muslim person i am expecting a prayer room because i am not feeling very free because of the prayer timing because this mall so far away from my home.

Great family place, amazing shops and outlets. Spacious parking location though I expect it to be filled up when the mall fully opens it's doors for business. All in all it I a really good place. I docked 1 star for security which was lapse, no map or guide to help you easily locate where you want to go to.

The place is fully stocked with different businesses and it's beautiful. I like that the convenience was thoughtfully designed to look beautiful. I wish there was soap in the bathroom though.
I gave it 4 stars because of the lack of proper packing especially for a business hub that hosts multiple businesses.

This place is really beautiful and clean.
It’s a 4 star now because I only explored the ground floor perhaps on my next visit, there will be a reason for it to merit a 5 star rating. It felt like I was on holiday visiting a nice town centre or mini mall. I loved it.
I liked the little cafe right in the middle.
I had pastries & iced tea and it was good.

Beautiful shopping mall! Ambiance being the selling point! It's quite clean too.. didn't feel rowdy  or crowded on a week day. It houses a few nice spots: (1) Orisun Art Source - a beautiful Art source/ gallery (2) Ur Cafe- a simple cafe with a few good bites/selections (3) a Pharmacy (4) a spa (4) Hylook- men's traditional wear store!

I bet there are more, but I didn't have enough time to tour the place entirely!

Unkept. Nothing really worthwhile to offer. Even the coffee shop didn’t have anything meaningful. I left after looking around for 10 minutes. The place has potential but not well managed. Looks terrible.

This place has a very amazing aesthetic, it's a cool place, designed to the last detail, definitely alot of thought put into the interior decor and architecture, it's a must visit place if you are ever in Abuja , go take pictures with friends and grab a bit in the amazing restaurants and cafes they have there

Went to the pharmacy,  polite staff, drugs are affordable,  however no pictures cos of their policy and I had to respect that. Has other amazing shops. Entered Cheeries Supermarket,  lovely place, so.e things are quite pocket friendly while others ain't.  Aisle attendants were helpful.  Directions on point

I love this mall. It is located in a cool place. I like the fact that one could get computer services and fashion designers at the mall. It is quite spacious and very decent. I can see some shops for studying abroad services and exams. I can also see a barber's shop. There's also a bakery for freshly baked food. I also noticed you could get a taxi to your destination easily outside the mall. I can see some shops which look like offices too.

My one stop shop for whenever I need something, from bread and sugar, eggs, pharmaceutical drugs or electronics. Whatever the time of day H-Medix is available, their 24hrs service is truly impressive. Convenient parking too.

It's a walk in and shop all you want experience...
I did pay more visits here cos they have my everyday needs and more.

They also have counters for cash and card well separated avoiding long queues.
Just getting more amazing everyday, I love this place
Fantastic food. There’s also an open roof (sky light), beautiful rock wall with flowing water, and a clean cool breeze. Absolutely stunning spot.
This is a clean and well-maintained place, providing a comfortable and pleasant atmosphere. The items are lovely and of good quality, adding to the overall charm and appeal.

This has to be not just my favorite mall in Abuja, but one of my favorites worldwide! Many products of quality under one roof! (food, perfume and so much!  The bakery is amazing too, quality baked products, amazing coffee and cakes, you have to try their croissant. I tried the resturant  (express cafe and resturant) and was  truly impressed by the food, and amazing service. The staffs and manager were very polite and humble. I definitely recommend paying this place a visit !!!

International Women's day out with family to a place we all like. Dunes on Sundays is just fantastic for lunch. Great meals, salads and icecream! Today we were served by Adams and it was just an all round good experience.
Awesome service. My waitress Ms. Gift was particularly kind and made sure I was comfortable. Their meals are tasty too

The sad thing about writing this review in 2025 is that the state of the Nigerian economy has taken a huge toll on large businesses and department stores like ShopRite.

I visited this store on a Saturday afternoon, which is supposed to be peak hours and the very low traffic and underwhelming array of produce and items on the shelves was very sad to see. A store that used to be very bubbly and full of human traffic shopping and working has now become a near ghost town.

Here's hoping the economic downturns are reversed in the nearest future so we don't lose yet another ShopRite.

On the positive side, the store still retains its high standards of hygiene and orderliness even though the product range has greatly narrowed with lots of empty or scantily stacked shelves.

I had a great time here.

The mall provides access to anything you want to shop, ranging from food, to personal items, gifts, clothes, spas, jewelry, and what have you.

Tight security, neat parking spaces, 24/lighting, access to the major road, convenience, Wheel chair accessible entrance and parking.

My time here was fun and exciting!

Like all Novare malls I’ve visited, this falls under same standards which is excellent. Very popular for housing Shoprite as one of its major stores at the mall. The surroundings are always very neat and well maintained. I really commend the maintenance culture because every time I revisit, I meet the same Novare mall if not better. You will find multiple stores like Grab and Go, Genesis, Mr. Price, Pep Store, Miniso, Time Keepers etc You’ll basically find similar stores in all Novare malls.

Some of the spectacular effects about ShopRite are neatness and coordination you feel when you get to their malls. Though, I noticed something different at the Apo 2 ShopRite which I hope they can fix because it doesn't feel good to see what I noticed and called the attention of the staff to it.

A great one-stop-shop, shopping complex, where you can get almost everything you need...ideal for the family. You can get groceries, perfume shops, boutique, super market, pharmacy, Banks, ATMs, barbers shop. Eatries. Beautiful atrium, designer shop...great brands, winery...gift shops.
There are beautiful sit out within the complex , children friendly spaces and awesome parking and impeccable security.

Novare Central Mall is decent but not impressive. It’s conveniently located and has a fair range of shops and eateries. The environment is mostly clean, though some facilities look a bit worn. Staff service varies — some helpful, others indifferent. Parking can be stressful. Overall, it’s an average experience that could be much better with improved maintenance and organization.

I had a great time at Novare Central Mall. The place is clean, modern, and easy to access with good parking. There are lots of food and shopping options, making it a nice spot to hang out, grab a meal, or relax with friends in Abuja.

A nice Serene, clean and less crowded place to hang out, shop and work, they have variety of stores here from clothing to restaurants, furniture, studio etc they have shared working spaces and halls for booking ... They have a spacious parking lot, though
paid at some point. Overall everything is quiet organized here and they have a wheelchair accessible entrance and clean toilet facilities and active  security.
Nice clean and peaceful Mall, with event halls, offices, retail outlets and restaurants especially my favorite @plattersandcorestaurant .

A well organized shopping mall, with adequate security and provision for parking spaces, the shopping mall is also equipped with an elevator, rest room at strategic location on every floor. The halls are well lit and provided with Air Conditions and provision for projectors are in place. The security personnel are well behaved, and always helpful in giving direction to venue for certain gathering, offices, or functions within the mall.
This complex has struggled to stay relevant due to it's location and number of a to e shops since it's inception. Located close to the old Fotogold studios, the shops see low patronage.
Shopping complex with shops offering different products. Bought car tyre and car battery from a shop there.

I recommend the shopping complex for diverse needs. Variety of Car tyres and car batteries as well as other accessories are available at competitive prices as well. Accessibility and customer service around here is also commendable possibly due to competition. You can buy and change four tyres here in less than an hour as the whole process is automated in a very conducive atmosphere.
Where to can buy good Electrical & electronic devices but they lack packing space
Good layout and parking space. But few human traffic

Mambolo Mall is a shopping destination located in Wuse Zone 2, 1 & 3 Mambolo St, Abuja 904101, Federal Capital Territory, Nigeria. It is well located & known for its accessibility & variety of stores. A very beautifully designed & well constructed mall, it is set on three floors & home to several business. The businesses include; a supermarket, pharmacy, fast food truck, beauty & barbing salon, finance firm, Beauty & spa. The mall is generally open from 8 AM to 10 PM daily, including weekends. The mall has a central airconditioning system & a lift (elevator) that are functional. The location is strategic at the intersection of Mambolo Street & the popular/busy Olusegun Obasanjo Way that terminates inside the Wuye District of the city. Featured stores & services offered in the mall include a variety of businesses, offering different products and services. Prominent among the businesses is Costcutter Supermarket which is a major tenant in the mall providing a diverse range of household items, groceries & general goods options. There is also Tripple A Kiddies; which is a one-stop shop for children's & baby items, including clothing, shoes, school bags, toys, & products for new mothers. An on-site pharmacy (Tonia Pharmacy) is located here. A financial services company office (Page Financials) is located in the mall. Grand Square is a prominent ultramodern shopping mall & supermarket located at 270 Mohammadu Buhari Way in the Central Business District of Abuja. Established in 2005, it serves as a "one-stop-shop" featuring a supermarket (or properly termed hypermarket) with an expansive electronics department, & various dining options. The core services & departments include supermarket & groceries which offers a wide range of local & imported groceries, household essentials, & bulk goods. They also have a bakery & pastries section renowned for its fresh bread (including the popular Grand Family Loaf), cakes, meat pies etc. The electronics & home appliances section boasts of original home appliances, furniture, electronics etc, with after-sales services. For dining, the Le Petit Square is a gourmet restaurant serving delicious foods as well as an ice cream stand famous for its reasonably priced affordable scoops. The supermarket is open from Monday – Saturday 8:30 AM – 8:00 PM but closed on Sundays. However, while the supermarket typically closes at 8:00 PM, the onsite restaurant, Le Petit Square may stay open until 10:00 PM. Grand Square Supermarket & Stores was founded by Grand Products Company Ltd as a one stop shop providing various goods & services from consumables, to electronics to custom home fittings etc. It combines all the business activities of Grand Products Company Ltd into one holistic shopping experience with a focus on providing a variety of premium products at an affordable price. Grand Square Supermarket & Stores currently operates 2 hypermarkets & 2 supermarkets, spread across three major cities in Nigeria. The flagship hypermarket is located in the Nigerian Capital of Abuja, which is the subject of this review. The company also operates one hypermarket in Ikeja, & another supermarket located in Victoria Island, both in Lagos State, which is the commercial capital of Nigeria. In addition, the company also operates a supermarket in Kano; the economic capital of Northern Nigeria. The hypermarket in Abuja is set in about 15,000 sqm of gross leasable area over 2 levels, while the tenant mix comprises 80 stores emphasizing basic retail categories like apparels & goods, with medium diversity in fashion, entertainment, or international dining. Its a clean, well-stocked supermarket with a great variety of groceries, household essentials, & freshly baked items. The environment is well organized & comfortable, & the staff are generally courteous & efficient. The bakery section stands out for its consistently fresh bread & pastries. Though prices can be slightly higher than average, but the quality of the product makes it worthy. There is free on-site parking available, though it can be a bit crowded at busy times. Uniformed security attendants are always available to assist in finding a space. For payments, they accept cash, credit cards, debit cards (Visa/Mastercard), & NFC mobile payments. The facility is equipped with wheelchair-accessible entrances, elevators, & restrooms. Grand Square Shopping Mall in Abuja is one of the city’s oldest & most convenient & well-organized places to shop. In fact, it is always reference point whenever one is looking for genuine & high quality electronics, home appliances, fashion apparels, fresh delicious bread etc. The environment is clean, spacious, & well-stocked with quality groceries, household items, & imported products. The wine section is renowned for its authentic varieties that may not be found elsewhere. The butcher's department is also notable for fresh, quality meat. The on-site pharmacy (Tonia) is equally reputed for genuine imported drugs. It's signature ice cream is frequently cited as one of the best in the city. For assurance, there're adequate security personnel & staff to guide customers, as well as armed security personnel deployed. Its definitely a great spot for a smooth & stress-free shopping experience Abuja

Prince Ebeano Supermarket is truly one of the best shopping destinations I’ve experienced. From the moment you walk through the doors, you’re greeted with a clean, organized, and welcoming environment that makes shopping both convenient and enjoyable. ​Sahad Stores is more than just a supermarket; it’s a bustling retail hub, impressively housed within a four-story shopping complex. While its large size means it can get quite busy, particularly on weekends, this is where you go when you need everything under one roof. The store maintains a robust team, ensuring lots of staff are available across all floors, making it easy to get help and ask questions quickly. Security is also a clear priority, with dedicated security guards on each level of the complex, providing peace of mind while you shop.
​The main challenge for shoppers is the location's access, as there is limited parking available on the ground floor and off-street. It’s definitely something to factor into your travel plans.
​However, the reason Sahad Stores is so highly recommended and worth the trip is simple: the discounted prices of the goods. The value offered here is genuinely amazing and makes the effort of navigating the busy complex worthwhile. If you prioritize massive selection and substantial savings, Sahad Stores is a must-visit location for making your grocery and household shopping budget go further.

Restaurant Review: OBIRI Restaurant, New GRA

Tucked away in the heart of New GRA, OBIRI Restaurant is easy to miss at first glance — quite literally. The restaurant’s name is obscured by a black nylon covering, and its entrance isn't front-facing like most eateries. Instead, it's discreetly located at the side, giving it an almost hidden charm. But once you step inside, you're in for a pleasant surprise.

Despite its understated exterior, OBIRI opens up into a spacious and beautifully designed interior. The aesthetics are warm and inviting, with an abundance of greenery that adds a cozy, laid-back feel. Thoughtfully placed No Smoking signs remind guests of the restaurant's clean and calm atmosphere.

OBIRI isn’t just about good food. It’s also a spot to unwind and have fun. The restaurant offers a variety of games including snooker, ayo, and whot, making it a great hangout for both casual diners and groups of friends. In the evenings, the vibe becomes even more lively as music fills the air.

Affordability is another highlight. OBIRI delivers value without compromising on experience, making it a solid choice for anyone looking to enjoy great food, chill vibes, and light entertainment in GRA.
Final Thoughts
If you're in New GRA and want a low-key yet satisfying dining experience, OBIRI Restaurant is definitely worth checking out. Just don’t miss the entrance!
