review_text: I visited the center to get a drug, it was nice. The service here was courteous. When it started raining, the accommodated everyone and made available their restrooms which was surprisingly very clean. The supermarket and drugstore there were quite the standard too as well as the children area playground.

Cool place to shop
Went during festivities and it was packed with people shopping and having fun.
A cool and serene environment with divers items to purchase, keep a date with Port Harcourt Mall and you'd be glad you did
It was nice been there

The Portharcourt city mall is a place to behold.it houses Filmhouse Cinemas, awesome and exquisite restaurants, Spar, mobile phone.shops, boutique and a lot of other household items.

The COVID 19 protocols are being observed as you're not allowed to step into the mall without putting in a nose mas or a face shield.

It's an accessible place from almost any part if Portharcourt. Once you tell any can driver you're going to SPAR, you will get a direction.
Nice place to shop but no crowd control incase of emergency or something else especially on weekends.
Unisex salon, wears, drinks and grocery stores all in one place.
Beautiful shopping complex
Good area for small shopping of wine and drinks
It's a nice place to shop.
Nice place to go and do some shopping

This is a good shopping centre, well stocked and well organised. The cashier at the pay desk was quite Friendly. The staff are good. The parking space needs expansion, the supermarket itself should be expanded for more products and space. The prices are good enough. A boutique and place for household items is upstairs, but no accessibility features  you go up by stairs
It's small but it's has things that you won't expect that from that size of a super market 😎
Nice experience really. Been shopping there for some Years now

A one stop grocery store that what your home needs...
One thing that turned me off is the space in between when looking for items. It's quite not a large one, you just have to be careful else you might just hit someone unconsciously.

Great shopping experience..
Genuine products on display for sale..

Within the vicinity and proximity to quick shopping..
It's a nice supermarket to meet your basic needs, the service is okay and wait times are regular. It's not a one-stop spot for all your needs, but it provides the essentials for daily loving.

Strategically located at the Rukpokwu roundabout! Heavily stocked with groceries, food items, children's toys, books and what have you. Staffers are readily available to offer helping hands to their teeming customers. Checking out was also seamless. The parking lots were relatively OK and it's free parking.

Inside isn't spacious. The goods aren't organised accordingly. Nonchalant and noisy staff; they prefer to pair up and gist out loud than help stranded customers plus they're rude abd dirty 🤮

Surprisingly, a supermarket didn't have granulated sugar and cocoa powder. Shame

In fact, this branch doesn't deserve any star.

Located at a strategic junction, makes market square a busy and hot spot.

The good thing is that u can drop by and pick up and or two things at the junction and continue with your journey especially if you are a traveller.

And they are always stocked, meaning u can come at this place anytime and find what u are looking for as long as they sell or support it.

There's no Much cue here during payment, except on weekends which is manageable.

This is another nice branch of Market Square, it's not an upscale building, it's was fully set up in the year 2019. It has lots of groceries and it's likes, including Provisions, toiletries, cakes, bread, Drinks (wines and other types), etc. Callus Miller is there too, where you can get all types of phones, Kilimanjaro Is also there, where u get other sweet soft snacks, different kinds of food, Nibbles Bread and Soft Drinks, Etc. Then there is the kili_shawama joint for your sweet Chicken, Beef or Mixed Grill Shawama.
They also made provision for public Restroom and it's accessable for wheel chair Users.
All the same, it's not so spacious compared to other branches and they still need to work on their customer services, especially the cashier area.

I had a genuinely enjoyable time at Ibom Tropicana Mall. One of the highlights for me was joining the kids to ride toy cars—a simple, joyful experience that made the visit feel truly special.

What stood out the most was how impressively clean and well-maintained the entire space is. From the beautifully kept exterior to the spotless interior, the mall radiates a sense of order and care. The greenery around the premises adds a refreshing touch that enhances the overall atmosphere.

Inside, you'll find just about everything you need—retail stores, essentials, and a range of outlets that cater to different tastes and needs. It’s more than a shopping destination; it’s a place to unwind, have fun, and enjoy quality time.

I absolutely love this place and would recommend it to anyone visiting Uyo or looking for a clean space to shop and relax.
I have been to Tropicana Mall thrice and I loved all the experiences, I can go there anytime and i will always enjoy it like it’s my first time.

Lovely mall in a strategic location and they have variety of stores there. Though the mall only have few stores open but overall it’s still a well maintained mall. The mall is somewhat too big for the crowd in Uyo but to be fair it’s actually a very beautiful mall.

Magnificent!

There's literally nothing you need you wouldn't find in the mall. Some stalls especially the fashion ones are quite pricey but you will definitely get quality items. Services like haircuts and salons are also quite cheap relative to states like Lagos and Abuja. You will get a good haircut for 1k with treatment and make beautiful braids for as low as 2 -3k unlike the 10-15k you will spend in Lagos.

Great experience overall

Tropicana Mall is beautiful and nice. It has good parking space which can contain many cars and is located in the heart of Uyo City.

The mall has different businesses and brands in it. The supermarket is operated by Marketsquare.

Generally, the environment is nice though there are some pertinent observations.
1) Most shops in the mall were empty and didn't have any business occupying them.
2) The HVAC system was not functioning. Most shops resort to using standing fans.
3) No cinema for viewing latest movies.

Overall, i had a good experience there.

*Expert Review: HavilahRoyaleBites' Small Chops at a Wedding Reception*

"I had the pleasure of working with HavilahRoyaleBites to cater our wedding reception, and I must say, their small chops were a resounding success! Here's my professional assessment:

- *Flavor Profile*: The variety of flavors offered was impressive, and each bite was packed with deliciousness.
- *Service*: The team was professional, courteous, and attentive, ensuring seamless service.

HavilahRoyaleBites' small chops were a hit with our guests, and I'd highly recommend them for any event. Their attention to detail, quality of food, and exceptional service make them a top-notch catering choice.

*Rating: 5/5*

Perfect for weddings, corporate events, and special occasions."

It's in a choice place,just at before Rumuokwuta there. ♿❌It wasn't bad for shopping but can be bugger and better. Much smaller than I than I anticipated. I have been at other branches of welcome you shopping places and they are fairly bigger than this. Nevertheless,it has the upstairs sections as usual for clothes,stationeries and other household items. No car park available here and the entrance is not accessible for special needs.
Well I give it a 4 out of 5,they are good though
Beautiful supermarket, a place for family shopping, things are sold in a good fare affordable price

Great place. Quality items sold for fair prices.
Customer- friendly staff too.

It’s an alright place to visit. Plenty of stores, and an arcade for kids too. They have perfume stores, tech counters, shoe and toy stores, you can buy makeup and a bunch of other things. Also there are food options. It’s a bit hot with no fans except near the arcade. One store I really liked was Ardith’s glitz and glam on the 2nd floor. Air conditioned and beautiful clothes!! Overall it seems a bit old and a little worn down but you can find plenty of items you may need. I would visit again.
They have seen better days! I used to like their Toast beef rice with fish! It was the best!
Looking for place of relaxation and good meal ..look no further big treat really serves
When it comes to food, they way ahead of the competition. Tasty meals

Big treat sited directly opposite the airforce base in portharcourt, Nigeria.
Is a place to be,pastries and all kinds of drinks and dishes,other items sold too,I love to chill there

Very Eastern coded. If you've been any stores in the east this would be no stranger to you. Three floors but the most upper one is yet to be filled. Ground floor is air-conditioned.

Tacky goods dey but great goods dey. They have the poorest ice cream stock though. 🥲

I'm not too sure about if things are expensive here or not.

The first thing I noticed was that the products were not properly arranged on their respective shelves. However, I must say that the supermarket is stocked with a variety of products, despite the fact that the staff I encountered seemed somewhat reluctant to help. Overall, it is not a bad place for a quick shopping trip.
Very nice place to get most things you need.

This place caters for your shopping needs. Here, you can get almost all your household items, furnitures, beverages, drinks, frozen foods, pastries, beauty kits, stationeries, detergents, soaps, hair creams, baby foods & clothes, etc..

The air conditioner is standard & cools your body while you take items off the shelfs. The ground floor is for your needs like drinks, detergents, diapers, processed food items & accessories, pastries, soaps, detergents, oral care kits, etc. while the first floor is for your wants like furniture, gift items, utensils, stationeries, etc.

There is an ample parking space & the security men are very professional.

This supermarket serves the Mgbuoba, NTA, Majesty Estate axis. It's the biggest supermarket between NTA and Obiri Ikwerre.

Timeless Super Store is located at a strategic area, along NTA-Ozuoba Road, Opposite the Saint Hermont Hospital around the National Open University of Nigeria (NOUN) area,  Port Harcourt. It has a sizeable parking lot, an accessible leeway for the physically challenged, tight security, Good aroma, well-lit and customers friendly staff. The items are well Merchandised and prices are really attractive.
Try to visit the pharmacy store upstairs, and find time to look around to get kiddies products around the pharmacy area. Kitchen Solution, Personal care and other House-keeping tools are available too. It took me months of visiting before I discovered the pharmacy store upstairs.

There are more customers on weekends and evening rush hours. Thanks!

A market strategically located in the heart of PortHarcourt city with so many branches. It's well known for affordable wide range products. Groceries, electronics, assorted drinks, home appliances, furniture etc. The GRA branch has ample of car park

They sell expired products because of carelessness or negligence…Imagine having to keep checking for expiry dates on everything you pick up to buy so that you’re safe… best option is to totally avoid them and buy your things from other reliable stores.

The Market Square in GRA Phase II (PH) is undergoing positive improvements. They have recently renovated the exterior entrance of their shop, which looks very appealing. They consistently maintain the quality of their products and provide excellent staff service. Great job, and keep striving for further enhancements!

It's a good place to buy different products from food items to household items.
Customer service is fairly good. There are usually long queues towards evenings especially during weekends, it's surprising the management haven't done anything about this predictable occurrence.
Recently saw a notice that prohibits people from taking photos inside, I don't know why and it feels counterproductive in my opinion.
They have wheelchair accessible parking and wheelchair accessible entrance.
This market square is relatively bigger than some of their other branches here in Port Harcourt.
Overall it's a good place to buy things, I can't really comment on their prices though.

Charlson luxury hotel is a place u really wil want to be, if u really need something Unique an foreign, something Cool, there food also is very nice been prepared by well experience Cook's. Giv it a try.

The atmosphere there is good
Will suggest your security stamp customers receipt instead of tearing them......

Thank you

Nice and quiet environment. Ideal for shopping varieties. Prices are quite reasonable. It is located in a central location with food accessibility. Close proximity to kilimanjaro where meals can be easily grabbed. A barbershop is also adjacent to it

Market Square Rumuodara was superb as usual and busy because it was seated at the junction.

You get a lot of people troop in here because it's easy to locate and you can get what you can buy here.

There's Kilimanjaro here too opposite for your fast food and meat pies and what have you.

They have a lot of parking spaces and Shawarma corner for the tasty bite.

You also get a pharmacy and a barbing salon here too. Check it out.

Market square is a supermarket located virtually in every corner of Port Harcourt city.
Though it cant be compared to a mall but it's okay considering its size.
You can't basically get everything you want here..
They don't sell groceries here.. children toys cant be found here too, bicycles, electronics, clothes etc..
What is sold here is just provisions, drinks, snacks, ice creams etc..just normal store contents .
What actually brings most people here is the "bread" ..as at the day I wrote this review 16th Nov 2022, the bread costs N800.
great place to shop for everything. they have variety of goods and the presence of other businesses like chicken republic and Kilimanjaro

Blossom Mall, Oroazi, is a very beautiful shopping mall that catches your attention within 500 metre radius from its position.
The design and finishing give it a calm, modern, and welcoming feel, and the well-planned layout allows different types of businesses to operate comfortably while displaying their shops clearly to people passing by.

Overall, it is a nice shopping mall. 👍🏾
Beautiful and cool environment
Exceptional Plaza. New and Clean

This is another good and lucrative branch of market square shopping centre. I always the numerous amount  or pay points they have. They have 12 !!! It's quite commendable, and I believe that will carter for rush hours of customer. The car park is very wide too, they have a ramp for wheelchair ♿ at the entrance. The quality of the product and price is fair enough. They have a very wide range of products, groceries,cold food,provisions ,toiletries toys etc. The customer service and security is above pass mark. Nice ambience for a relaxating shopping.

Its a one stop supermarket hence the name.. Tho u have to drop ur handbag outside, there is a notice that says no photography/phones.. The supermarket is spacious and the customer service is good and fast.. With affordable prices on some items.. Their puffs are so good, their sardine bread is also very nice.. The atmosphere is spacious and airy..There are no queues at the pay point...
There is enough parking space for almost everybody.. Its  a 9.5 out of 10..

This is a nice place that has one of the best bread in this vicinity. They have different products which include dairy, milk, porridge, custard, milk supplements, tea and coffee, snacks & nuts, breakfast cereals, water, soft drinks, energy drinks, prepared food, butchery, spices, sauces, jam, sugar, canned food, cooking oil, sweeteners, cake mix, spaghetti, pasta, noodles, rice, flour, household items, toilet rolls, flasks, kitchen accessories, glassware and crockery, gift items, party items, cutlery, baby food, dental products, baby lotions and lot more
Its okay located at Ada George Road it's a nice supermarket where you get a lot of things in-store shopping... nice meals and freshly baked bread... its cool

I was really impressed with Market Square here in Port Harcourt, it wasn't like they had anything out-of-this-world there except of course the night king who was standing there with the white bottles of Johnnie Walker White Walker #GOT. The staff where frendly & the ladies patronising to activate sales in a nice way, even though I doubt they can do that if I had a female escort. The products were well stacked, the aisles were well labelled making movement around quite easy while you shop. Most deff, I will visit this spot next time I'm in Port Harcourt

A nice place for shopping. It's still new so everything and everyone works as expected. There is a parking space outside, I don't know if it will be enough during festive seasons. It has a wheelchair accessible parking and entrance.
It looks a little smaller than other popular malls but I could still get all I wanted.
The workers seem courteous as well as the security.
Over all I'll say it's a nice place to shop and the environment is calm and not rowdy.

Update 30th March 2024:
Prices have changed a lot. Quality and quantity of products and items have been reduced, but most importantly, i have an issue with their food scales. The scales look like they have been adjusted because when you weigh a food item, the price comes out ridiculously high, it's annoying.

Loved the place, and being my first time, it was a delightful experience. There was a lot to choose from, and the varities were endless. It was neat, cool, and just had a good vibe.

The prices were not outrageous as I expected, even better than some big names. The cashiers were not bad either, I forgot to get her name that attended to me, but she was friendly and made me spend more.

Totally would go back every second I get, I hope they remain faithful sha.

I love how spacious and well lit this mall is. Parking space is also well designed and accessible. The food options included alot of variety amd also very affordable and delicious. I was also very happy to find a particular type of face mask that I had been looking for at the mall. I look forward to going back again. My only criticism, the gutters around the place smell awful. I hope the management does something about it.

Hyper city is a super market, a modern one to be precise.

You can buy your groceries, food items and other home appliances here.

I like the place because it is well organized in store shopping, well categorized sections to find what you are looking for easily.

And they have a lot of parking space and security.

Am sure you will love this place, if you stay around try them out.
Not all electric appliances can be shopped here

*HavilahRoyaleBites: Where Every Bite is a Delight!*

"I'm absolutely obsessed with HavilahRoyaleBites' cakes! Here's why:

- *Moist and Flavorful*: Each cake is a symphony of flavors and textures that will leave you wanting more.
- *Beautifully Crafted*: The presentation is stunning, with intricate designs that showcase the baker's skill and creativity.
- *Quality Ingredients*: You can taste the difference that high-quality ingredients make - every bite is rich and decadent.
- *Perfect for Any Occasion*: Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or just need a pick-me-up, HavilahRoyaleBites' cakes are the perfect choice.

The team at HavilahRoyaleBites truly understands the art of cake-making, and their passion shines through in every detail. If you're a cake lover like me, you owe it to yourself to try HavilahRoyaleBites!

*Rating: 5/5*

I'll be back for more (and so will my taste buds)!"

It was a nice time, the space of this emporium is small but there are staffs almost at every point, so you can easily ask them about any items.
When I was there, there was a power outage but within 5 seconds, power was restored in the facility.

A very nice place at Rumuola for shopping. They have a very wide range of products,groceries,household items,cold food,drinks,wines, perfumes,wrist watches,clothing etc. It's a very nice place in general. The ambience is cool enough, although I went during working hours so it wasn't busy.
The parking spaces are of good size. I counted about 4 paying points. That always interests me because during rush hours that's where the delay comes from. ♿❌. You go up the 1st floor by stairs so it's not accessible,although the main entrance itself is not.
Customer service was good,they were courteous enough.

This is a shopping center of choice as it is vastly stocked with a large range of products from fresh baked pastries to beverages & provisions, cosmetic products, kitchen utensils, aesthetic art pieces, wines & soft drinks, cloths to your everyday house hold items. Best of all, their prices are competitively quite affordable as their quality is certain.  I've Never regretted yet.

This is a one-stop shop for households, electronics, cosmetics and provisions. Assorted and high quality branded mobile phones are also available here including after sales services. One of the best and highly patronized shop in the heart of Port Harcourt with good parking space.
Very good supermarket in SHAGAMU, try to  experience their services, love ❤ it
One of the best and largest shopping mall in port Harcourt.

Amazing Service
Thanks to Everyday Supermarket for giving the best price in the market for electronics and electrical equipment.
The service was amazing. The items were just as advertised and disolayed. The quality of the electronics was exactly what  I expected .
Overall a pleasant experience shopping with Everyday Supermarket.
I would definitely recommend this to the people I know.
For all your shoppings, the place to be.💯👍

A complete home shopping destination, this has been my local for about a decade. However, the variety on the shelves is growing a little sparse recently. The staff are also kinda nonchallant towards shoppers. Their closure time appears to fluctuate and be unpredictable. Just a couple of observations

Their food is getting progressively worse. pasta with poorly chopped ingredients, beans with canda, Chinese fried rice with way too much onion, stews that taste undone, pepper soup with wrong flavors, the head chef needs to be changed the previous one was better. Rather than this the shopping experience is great just leave the food out of it
This report is linked to the Peter odili road branch

For port Harcourt standard,  its an alright supermarket. Doesnt have wheel chair access, the aisle are small so it gets crowded really easily. The cashiers are few, they have 8 stations but typically are always 4/5 people on duty leading to really long queues. Honestly ill rather go to spar than here because spar has way more goods on offer. Not sure about the price difference though
It's pretty loaded with various items,  food, clothing, furniture, cookware, souvenirs, books, provisions...etc, just name. It's stress-free sorting out your list

This place is a great place for  shopping as it provides efficient services, a parking lot,etc. security and customer satisfaction is their main priority. It also supports cashless transaction system as POS is provided.
Shop with them and be happy you did.

They got a  wide range of products for  affordable prices. Most people go there to get their fresh bake bread because it's always hot and fresh. if you want to get your homewares and food stuffs.  it's a good place to shop.

One of the biggest shopping brands in Port Harcourt. The stay out till late night; 10pm. Wide variety of household items, gifts food and hardware, electronics and some furniture also listed. Their fresh oven baked bread is worth trying.

I love Everyday supermarket bread
It's the best😍😍🤩🤩 is it possible for me to place order for the bread, I will love to know because I am craving for it. And I live in akure which is far.

It's okay, it's a nice supermarket and it as an accommodation or rather a hotel within the building and it's a big building..... the hotel is still owned by the same person everyday Emporium.... you can buy a lot of things from the supermarket it has a corner for cake sales but the cake stand is owned by another person it's called cake heaven, there you have varieties of cake different type of cake there.. it has a fast food in the building as well called De Choice Fast Food.... all good...
Just today I was very glaringly cheated. I picked a tiny bottle of dish soap that was N690 at the counter, N1,200 in their system and they charged me N2,300 for it. Run! They are thieves there

This is a beautiful upscale supermarket, it is located at Plot 26, Elelenwo Street G.R.A Phase II, Port Harcourt. It has almost everything you will need as a human being in all aspects of life. Home, office, etc. All kinds of groceries, frozen foods, bread, foods stuffs, variety of snacks/drinks and ice cream. De choice fast food, can be located inside the building, where you can get all kinds of tasty meals, including snacks and Cakes. You can dine inside or do take outs. They have good customer service and accessibility of wheelchair entrance and parking. The outside environment isn't to too spacious but enough for customers to park their vehicles.

The best place to get all your groceries. They stand out in terms of proper quality checks, that means you don't have to worry about expired goods being sold on the shelves. It also has a pharmacy, a collection of premium liquor and a range of frozen foods. Going up the stairs inside the supermarket, (which most people might miss because of it's location to the left, by the checkout counters), is the departmental area with a selection of choice home furnishing items, electronic gadgets and toys for kids. In addition, there is a good number of staff who are always willing to assist customers with their shopping.

I do my monthly shopping at Everyday Supermarket, Peter Odili. Forgot to buy two things so I  gave my maid a list to show any of the attendants there, since she is an illiterate. One of the items given to her wasn't what I sent her. She went back to exchange it for what i originally wanted but Everyday didn't have the item but refused to give her a refund because they claimed they had inputed the item into their system so there was nothing that could be done. Followed her and same thing was said to me. They said the best they can do is let me pick something else but definitely no cash back so i walked out of there leaving the item behind. Mattoris Supermarket has a far better customer service and their things are definitely cheaper so I'm definitely never going back to that silly Everyday.

The grocery store owners or managers should train their cashiers properly.  This is the fourth time I am having to drop things I have shopped for all because there is no change. The lack of change is not only the issue but the attitude of the dark-slim cashier sitted by the side of the grocery aisle.  She always murmur about customers disturbing for change and how she is tired.
She will only keep driving customers like me and others away. People will rather walk down to other places to shop where they won't have to drop their goods or part away with their change in order to shop.
Wide range of options, competitive prices and very courteous attendants!
Good place for shopping... A complete market for all your needs..

Spacious, comfortable shopping experience. Most groceries and household products can be found here.

Wheel chair access and exit are available.
The manned police security post provides extra security, especially for late evening shopping.

There's a Pharmacy and a phone shop here.
There is also a rest room for convenience.

Cash or payment through POS are accepted.

It is a great place to shop. They have everything you may need with staff willing to help to ensure you find what you are looking for. From beverages, seasonings, bread, phone & accessories the have it all

There's variety which is one thing I love
but please they should make this pice tags.on the shelves more visible
it sucks when I put an item into my cart and head to check out and then I'm told a different price meanwhile I saw something else on the counter
Nice experience. Good customer service. Everything you want is here

Shop with satisfaction, around ABA road
Located between Artillery Junction and Shell RA with a pinkish experience

HyperCity! The newest shopping mall/departmental store in Port Harcourt. I could resist the urge to get in and see what it's like. The majesty pose it displays from outside is hard to resist. You get in and are instantly awed by the surreal ambience.

The fresh feel, look and smell of something brand new that was thoughtfully constructed. The architecture and aesthetics are impressive.

The set up is convenient. The store is spacious and allows for free human traffic. It's easily the largest store in Port Harcourt now.

They have a very large variety of product offerings and you can get all that you need as far as grocery shopping is concerned.

The premises are also beautiful, except for limited parking space.

I definitely recommend.

Gorgeous, modern grocery store! They sell everything you could ever think of; generators, wine, international food, seafood, electronics of all kinds and regular food items like bread etc. they even have a food court! I had a great time there and ordered food from the food court. Super clean, and well organized. My only issue is there is no seating near the food court. Def a missed opportunity. Expect longer wait times and lines in the evening.

Rich shopping mall. Bravo to their chefs. They  know what they are doing. The 3 meals there i tasted was great. Good parking space. Police station close by.

One thing that is missing in the mall is that  goods should have a category name on top at the glance of anyone who walk in the mall so they can access what they want on time. The management should look into this. At entrance you can see wine section easily. Written bold.

My first experience at the famous Hyper City Mall was awesome.

I got few items at fair rates. Most enjoyed was the ambience and cool background musical play.

A fresh introduction to PH’s shopping industry, Hypercity does not disappoint - especially being the only supermarket in the Oil City which stocks IKEA products.

The Access road is fresh and slick, the layout is spacious, air conditioning is superb, the facility (newly built by Julius Berger) is expectedly pristine.

Parking is smooth, albeit could be inadequate during peak days.

Limited options for cooked food available, albeit the value point leaves a lot to be desired.

Recommended for grocery shopping. 👍🏾

A good shopping place. Not too elaborate. I always like the fact that they are about 4 pay points. That reduces the waiting time after shopping. The car park is okay as well,not too big though. Good security at the entrance. Customer service  fair.
♿✖ Not accessible for wheelchairs. The restroom is okay but can be better,it's only one for male and female alike.
It's okay... nice supermarket

Their prices are quite cheap and goods are of good quality. Their inventory management is good too, I've never seen an expired product on the shelf. Customer relations is good, the environment is clean and easy to navigate. There is outdoor security, and parking is safe.

An easy to locate supermarket along the second half of Ada George Road in Port Harcourt. Has a parking space for about ten cars, no wheelchair accessible ramp and parking lot.
Their prices are fairly reasonable and one can get most of their home needs and stationary items here. There are security guards and a restroom available for customers. Cash and POS payments options are available including home delivery services. You'll enjoy shopping here on a modest budget!

It is a Supermarket where one can buy groceries and other household items.
However, the supermarket has a small car parking space

The supermarket is nice, staffed with friendly and helpful workers, and stocked with a variety of products. These products range from daily care items, cosmetics, household products, ingredients, fruits, veggies, gift items, and more. The spice section is well-stocked with numerous options, including a great variety of spices. I was especially excited to find paprika there. However, the paypoint area is not very spacious. Nevertheless, the supermarket is a pleasant place overall.

Additionally, it's worth noting that there is a fast food restaurant called "De Choice Fast Food" located within the supermarket. They offer a variety of food options such as snacks, drinks, parfait, and more. It's a convenient addition for customers who may want to grab a quick bite to eat while they shop.
Newly built Clean environment spacious too, and there's a restaurant inside too(de choice fast food)
A place for good collections of CraftMount wall decor plaques
You can get most of the things you will need

♿✅ often use this supermarket for my shopping because it's in a very accessible location and it's proximity to transportation is quite helpful. It's just a place called location. It's a very modern shopping place. It has a ramp at the entrance for wheelchairs it also has a ramp to go upstairs to the choice restaurants which is remarkable. It's always well lit up and fully airconditioned.They have a wide range of stock ranging from household items to provisions to groceries to toiletries etc. There is an exclusive area for electronics as well. They have a bakery that offer fresh bread and snack everyday.

Calido is a really pleasant surprise, especially considering it’s located within the rather unimpressive grounds of Tahir Guest Palace. Once you get past that, however, it’s a beautiful rooftop spot with a lovely view of Kano that immediately elevates the experience.

Apparently, it’s a beloved birthday destination, there were multiple celebrations happening the same evening I visited, which added to the lively, upscale atmosphere. I was a guest at the hotel and stopped by Calido just for tea and dessert, so I can’t speak extensively on the full menu, but the tea was very nice and the tres leches cake was absolutely divine.

The ambiance is top-tier and the vibes are elite. I also really appreciated the wet wipes on the tables, small touch, big impact, and the service was attentive throughout. All in all, it’s a great spot for a chic evening out, celebrations, or a relaxed rooftop hang.

Cilantro is one of the best spots in Kano for a fine dining experience, especially if you enjoy Indian and Asian cuisine. The moment you step in, you notice the elegant ambiance, which makes it feel more upscale compared to most restaurants in the city. Whether you choose to sit indoors or in the outdoor lounge area, the setting is cozy, clean, and well-arranged.

The food is where Cilantro truly shines. Their butter chicken, tandoori chicken, and naan bread are some of the best I’ve had in Nigeria. The flavors are rich, the spices are well-balanced, and the presentation is always appealing. Their vegetarian options are also impressive, with well-seasoned curries that don’t feel like an afterthought. Portions are decent, though slightly on the pricey side—but you get what you pay for in quality.

Service is generally good, but it depends on how busy they are. On quiet days, the waiters are very attentive and polite. However, during peak hours, the service can be a bit slow, and you might need to call the staff’s attention more than once.

For anyone looking for a premium dining experience in Kano, Cilantro is definitely worth visiting. The atmosphere is great for a date, a family dinner, or even a business meeting. Just be prepared to spend a little more than you would at a regular restaurant, but it’s worth it for the food and ambiance.

review_text:
This review based on our one time experience and one one dish.(8/3/25)
It is a biriyani story, so please don't judge with other dishes.
We ordered 1 chicken biriyani and one mutton biriyani. What we received was plain rice (some coloured) and chicken /mutton curry in biriyani bowls.
If we want rice and curry why should we ordered biriyani. There was no biriyani spices no ghee and full of gravy. Also got one raitha even it was sweeter.
First of all I was planning to have a biriyani after long time. I didn't eat biriyani after reach kano. So I took restaurant suggestions from my friends. They said 'Bigbite' is a good option compared to others in Kano. But It was totally a disappointed choice (may others are more worse).
I was planning to complain to the manager but luckily one indian chef was passing through. I explained him the situation. He said if you want indian style or dham biriyani you should inform to waiter. Then they will inform kitchen. Otherwise they will do such a short cuts 🙄. It was a new information for me.
Tip : 1. If you a good biriyani please tell them make it dham or add spices.

Kano Farm Center is one of the most popular and reliable spots in Kano for purchasing mobile phones and all kinds of gadget-related accessories. Despite the name, it’s far from just being about farming—these days, it’s known for being a buzzing tech market right in the heart of the city.

Whether you’re looking for smartphones, chargers, Bluetooth speakers, earphones, power banks, memory cards, screen protectors, or other accessories, you’ll definitely find what you need here. The variety is impressive—you’ll see both brand-new and UK-used gadgets, as well as a wide range of price options to fit your budget.

One major advantage of Farm Center is its central location. It's easily accessible from almost every part of Kano, with transportation options like buses, Keke, and bikes readily available. It’s a go-to place for many people who want quick and affordable tech solutions.

However, like any busy market, you have to be very careful. There are trustworthy sellers, but there are also a few who might try to take advantage of customers who don’t know the market well. It’s always best to ask around or go with someone who knows how things work there. Bargaining is part of the culture, so don’t be shy to negotiate.

The environment can get quite crowded and noisy, especially during peak hours, but that’s expected in such a lively commercial area.

Overall, if you’re in Kano and need anything related to phones or gadgets, Farm Center is one of the best places to go. Just go prepared, stay alert, and you’ll likely walk away with a good deal.

Sufi Hypermarket, situated prominently on Zoo Road in Kano, is much more than just a retail branch; it is a cornerstone of the community and a definitive one-stop shopping destination. The hypermarket’s vast floor space is meticulously organized into distinct sections, each offering a comprehensive range of products designed to meet every conceivable household requirement.

Shoppers can explore a well-stocked pharmacy for health and wellness essentials, browse through aisles dedicated to high-quality kitchenware and household goods, and evaluate a diverse selection of furniture to suit various tastes and budgets. The electronics department is a hub for the latest gadgets and appliances, making Sufi Hypermarket a go-to for everything from daily necessities to significant purchases. The store’s philosophy, “Where Every Aisle is a Journey of Discovery,” comes to life in its thoughtfully laid-out environment, which encourages exploration and makes shopping an engaging experience rather than a mundane chore.

By seamlessly combining vast product variety, consistent availability, and a customer-focused approach, the Zoo Road branch has solidified its reputation as an indispensable part of daily life in Kano. There's also a fresh drink (fruits and nuts) stand as well as a food area which serves pizzas, sandwiches, meals and snacks. The food is good although a little pricey.

The workers were friendly and helpful although I've had an encounter when one was less than professional. He was the exception.

Not a bad place. It pretty much has all you're looking for but in bits. Quite a good variety of vegetables but they don't rotate them as often. They're sales girls are selectively rude. A quiet shopping environment with a variety of selections. I like it

This store had all the basic supplies I needed during my stay in Kano and at a good price.
I would advice they install industrial air conditioning instead of the fans they use because it was hot inside

It is neat and spacy. The interior is conducive also, as their cooling systems are efficient. However, there needs to be more work put into the preservation of perishables. Some of the items are not pleasant to the sight due to their perishability. The refrigeration need to be worked on.

A nice and wonderful 24 Hours service supermarket plus pharmacy attached.
You have got to visit this place.
Wide range of goods available
Haman super store is still cozy and has variety of day to day products and a nice addition to shoes section and phone accessories section. It has low traffic in the afternoon

Haman Super Store is a 24-hour store. They have a variety of good quality stocks, ranging from essentials, pharmacy, jewellery, cosmetics snacks and fast foods.

You won't miss the place as it is well located along Gwarzo Road opposite Second Gate, Janbulo (formerly known as Kabuga Housing Estate).
Haman is located along Gwarzo Road. That offer a 24/7 service.  It has a store, Pharmacy, and a Kitchen you can buy fast food from.
Is indeed a small shop, I love it for buying food stuff
Attractive and cheaper rate on all products
All you need in one provision store
An attractive shore in which everything is available
They have not or they are not selling cigrate
You can get all indian groceries

Best super market of Kano for Indian grocery.
More then 50 varieties of tea leaves available.
You have lots option to choose.
Most reasonable price.
Grocery, cakes, toys ....lots things available at one place.
Ample free parking space.

Love this place. I frequently visit this store. Most of the Indian products available at reasonable prices. Very cooperative and well informed staff. Well kept and displays with price helpful to decide what to buy. Very professional customer service with warm personal touch. Really appreciate it. Recently added vegetables section outside entrance area. Vegetables are fresh and well packed and neatly displayed. The staff at the vegetables section very helpful. Love this place. It's the best place to get all your daily needs.

Best super market for Indians in Kano...
All house hold and grocery for Indians are available here in good quality and much varieties... Owner and staff are good in behavior and they are helpful... There are toys for children also available... Just missing price labels on their products rack...
Overall nice place for in-store shopping... Specially for Indians.
A good  shop has now improved most of the grocery item are available specially if you are looking for Indian food items available here

I cannot recommend this restaurant to anyone. Not only is their service extremely slow, they are also unfair and dishonest.
First of all, I ordered 2 milkshake drinks. 1 in store and 1 as a take away. Mind you each drink was Naira 10,000. The first strawberry milkshake i was served in store was okay. It was overly sweet and it had a slightly weird taste but it wasn't too bad overall. The second chocolate milkshake came in a much much smaller sizing than the one in store. Like im confused did I not order the same type of drink?
Secondly, the restaurant is so hot. The fans are barely working and the A/c was switched off even when there was light. The entire atmosphere was just so un-appealing The most annoying part of this whole experience was the obnoxiously loud music playing in the background. We could barely hear each other talking. We asked for the music to be turned down, which they did at first, but some minutes later, it was turned back up again. This was such a poor experience with this restaurant. Nothing could ever make me come back here. You guys really need to learn to do better!!
It's Super cool, Nice food, good and secured
They sell fake table water (Eva). It tasted so bad. I complained and the staffs acted dumb
one of the best places in ibadan,when clasic and convenience do collaboration lol
Nice atmosphere and staffs are courteous

I had a very bad experience here the waiter were rude the drink came late,we ordered for chicken wings and it took them over one hour to tell us later that it was not ready but the manager later came to apologize for the whole scenario apart from that there is a Photo Booth

A very neat place with great food and drink - it's worth every penny.
It's such a great place that I didn't want to leave. From the very interesting and beautiful design to the super cool ambience.
It is also a great location for some casual romantic meal.
It's so easy to give a 5 star for such a fresh, creative, innovative lounge with class.
Their chicken wings were absolutely delicious and my friends and I always enjoy our time here.
Not to forget, it features a great customer service too.
😀

I've gone to Latitude twice and I've quite enjoyed both times.

FOOD:
The first was to eat swallow and I must say for a restaurant with such a look and ambience, they have one of the best swallows in Ibadan (You can try ordering eba and egusi to confirm)
Take swallow over rice if you can.

Visited again recently but I must say I wasn't quite impressed with what I got.

DRINK:
Their fruit juice is very good!
But I went on to order a mocktail called "Father Abraham" and I have not tasted anything worse
Apparently the so called Father Abraham drink is a mix of malt and milk at an outrageous price of ₦4500!

AMBIENCE:
Visiting in the afternoon is very chill for dates or anything. Few people are in and you can really have a great time.

Visiting at night is a different ball game as there are mix of people ranging from young educated and uneducated to matured and elderly people.
Families also come in.
There's an open space that's suitable for sitting out at night.

There's also another section dedicated for even cozier moments

And the water fountain just close by gives it the right kind of vibe.

All in all, it's a pretty chill place to relax at any time of the day.

Their prices are good. And the food tastes great, with great portions. Atmosphere is nice and bubbly. Music was a bit loud inside the restaurant, couldn't really sustain a conversation. But the service is great and the food is delicious. Would definitely visit again.
Nice environment to enjoy spaghetti bolognese. Customer service is on point. The meals were delicious and awesome. The ambience is great. Intercontinental dishes is been served here. Enjoy

The service here was top notch. The servers are very polite and attentive. Food was really good. We had the Makinde Silver platter and even though they said it was for 3, 4 of us couldn’t finish it. Had to request for “pack to go”. Also had their Oreo milkshake which was heaven. All in all, this place is tops and would definitely do it again.

I was super satisfied and really enjoyed the get-together at Five Continents.
I had lunch on a sunny day at the Pacific Lounge, out on the patio. The weather was lovely, the scenery was just right. And the food. 10/10!! I had Smokey Jollof and wings - hands down the best meal I’ve had. I left there super satisfied and will definitely revisit when next I’m in Ibadan

The 5 continent is situated inside Golden Tulips building and there are 5 restaurants/lounges in here
1.The Nucleus: A restaurant on the ground floor where the water falls and flowers are. The sight is quite beautiful
2. Pacific Lounge : Called the VIP area of the restaurant (prices are slightly higher than that of Nucleus). This is restaurant/lounge that has a patio that overlooks the entire nucleus and the sight is really lovely. Good for a group hangout as I and a group of friends spent our evening here. Food was nice, cocktails were also heavenly.
3. Dragons: A Chinese restaurant on the ground floor of the Pacific building. Looks nice from outside. I don't know how the interior looks as I didn't enter.
4. The vibe: A lounge+club, operations here start in the evening around 5 and the building looks nice as well.
5. Something grill 😊(forgotten the name).. although it wasn't on sight on entering the 5 continents arena but what's done there is BBQ and grilled items I presume.

The experience was actually fun as the environment was quite lovely to take amazing pictures. I highly recommend

This is my second time here tho. And they still have their standards that’s impressive. But🌝all these decorations on the chicken were too much for the actual taste(I was expecting paradise in my mouth but Mo wa disappointed ). This whole chicken was not nice honestly (too soft and tasted like an overcooked boiled chicken without enough seasoning and a plain soup), though they should improve on it or better still use suya sauce instead of a cooked stew on it. Plus it took 1hr and a few minutes to bring the chicken too😒

If you are looking for a beautiful space with a nice ambience to match in Ibadan, then five continents is right for you. It’s a 5 in 1 restaurant/bar/ lounge inside Golden Tulip, Ibadan. Suitable for a lunch and dinner date. The waiters and waitresses are also courteous and waiting times are short. Also has a parking lot. Only wish they had more options on their food menu.

Been hearing about this place for a while and decided to try it out a few days ago. The food isn’t bad but it took about an hour for us to get it.

Milkshake was a bit too watery. Plantain and chips were superb. The fish was good-ish, it was easy to notice that it wasn’t fresh though.

Someone was having a birthday there and the noise was unbearable. I feel it would have made more sense if they booked the full restaurant for a few hours rather than mixing with other diners.

The food is good, but the customer service is not okay. There's lack of organisation, and that's why I rated it 1 star. I've been here twice. Food is good, customer service is not. They'll see a couple and serve main meals to one and starters to another. It makes no sense. If you see people together, you serve the same set of meal courses at the same time, not separately.

And then they say oh, they can't reheat a food that is cold before the customer would eat it. Why? Then the waiters don't get what's ordered completely, they make mistakes with it. I still rate the customer experience 1 star, which is too nice really. Too nice.

Edited: I've been there multiple times after that and the customer service was better. Lol. So I increased my rating to 3 star for service. Still not the best. I also increased atmosphere to 3, because I sat outside twice now and I preferred it to inside.
Nice ambience. Went with my kids and we all had a good meal. I loved the pizza and can easily say it’s the best in Ibadan however their seafood Alfredo is too creamy. I love their pina colada too

Nice atmosphere. The service attendants are friendly and orderly. The rates are affordable and the environment is clean. I think the peppered turkey could actually do with more pepper. I loved the butter chicken and naan. It was delicious. I had a good time overall.

Tamberma has a great calm ambience, so if you're a lover of a calm and homey spot, you'd love it there.

The food tasted great and yes, they sell one of the best (if not the best) pizzas in Ibadan. There are a lot of food choices as well, ranging from Nigerian to Chinese and largely Indian options. Not so much choices for drinks though but you'd be satisfied still.

Service was great as the waiters are readily available to take your orders and communicate with you in a friendly manner. You hardly see that these days.

Pricing are fair and comparable with other fine dining restaurants in Ibadan.

Had a great time here and will definitely be back for the pizza.

First of all i will like to give a special shout out to whoever decorated the place! It is beautiful and so not your regular kind of decor.

The ambience is great, though i do wish the would let in some daylight to brighten up the place a bit. Although, some people might be in love with the cozy feel and how it shuts out the world, i always like to know whats going on outside.

They have nice settings, beautiful bar, their service is a bit expensive by my standard, but hey! I'm just a trenches girl trying to enjoy a bit of the good life.

Their staff was courteous and adequate, the wait time for the food was a bit long for me, i wish they gave us something to do while we wait. A few games would be nice, like what, ludo, scrabble, etc just to keep us entertained while waiting.

The restroom was really clean, and that is a luxury you don't get everywhere.

I had the chicken and chips for #5,000, their beef something pizza - #8,000
And a few drinks.

Overall, i had a good experience here, and will like to come back 🥰

It’s was quite easy to locate with google map. Beautiful and refreshing atmosphere.
The food was nice- loved the butterfly prawn but the stemmed fish and vegetables wasn’t it(way too much veggies), also the suya salad❌
Service was slow(waited almost 30mins to get our drinks). Also it took way too long to get our food order.
The DJ played well so the vibe was great.

The restaurant was pretty good, on getting in you’re met with a very dim almost dark atmosphere with some ethnic/woody elements in the decor, it’s a nice idea but they could supplement with more bright lights to aid visibility and clearer pictures.

I ordered chicken-suya pizza and the cheese was sufficient (compared to Dominos pizza) but not really tasty.

The customer service was okay, nothing extra special, I guess we were invisible to the waiters for a while.

Overall it was nice experience

This is everything you need to know about the lounge.
It is easy to navigate the location on the map. They have limited parking space but are well-coordinated.
🔹The ambience is very nice, it's welcoming and not choked up as much as it can contain quite several people
🔹I love the interior decoration, but the aesthetics are not regular, I love the cosy feel but the only issue I had was the lighting, it should be worked on. You would be there and you won't know it's already late outside 😃
🤎The meals are affordable and well-cooked, and the portions are filling too( if you are going for Chinese soups, you can go for one for 2 people, it is very much )
🔹They have a nice picture backdrop at every angle and that alone is the spice(again lightening 🥲)
🔹They have a beautiful bar display and sitting, I love that you can get your privacy in the lounge. Their staff are well mannered and quick to your service.
🔹Lastly, if you are a mirror selfie lover, a quick run to the toilet would do, I love what they did with the space and also the toilet is clean🤭

I did enjoy my time there and I would recommend and even go back 💯

An upscale restaurant that also has a "lounge." Rather unassuming facade but pretty unique decor and ambience. Abundant seating of different settings.
Okay bathrooms, clean, at least the male.
The service was pretty decent, and the waitress, Afisat, was nice and attentive, easy to interact with,  extremely polite.
The food came on time, preceded by steaming hot towels. 👍🏽
I had Edikanikon (sic) with semo, quite tasty. The semo came in local pot, lined with leaves. Nice local touch, in a contemporary setting. The portions were generous.
My friend had the fisherman fried rice, which he said was surprisingly very nice and tasty. The presentation of the rice was quite nice as well. His friend had fried rice which he also said tasted nice as well.
The ac was not as cold as it should be though. There was limited parking, would be chaotic if they have a full house.
Overall experience,  I'll rate them a 7.5.

A nice outdoor space for relaxation. They have an interesting rule about dressing and appearance. There are quite a number of good food and drinks on the menu. Although food serving is much, didn’t particularly like what I ordered as some of the items were not properly grilled. Prices are relatively affordable. Also, service was a bit slow.

Had a nice time here. Went on a Sunday and it wasn’t crowded probably because it looked like it was going to rain.

The aura is lovely with good music blasting that one could dance and vibe to.

Had their cocktails which arrived almost immediately. Then their Stone platter which was ok the burger bread was crunchy though. Then had their Chinese rice and Asun.

The waiter was super nice and good looking. Nice service. He explained the different available cocktail to us.

Went there with my girls and we had an amazing time.. Good customer service, but our drinks were not really chilled, I guess it was because of the time of the day we got there. Their shawarma was okay, it came with French fries which made it more inviting.. Their food was okay too.. Their environment was dope, we went there in the morning so we took really beautiful pictures.. I really enjoyed my time there and I'll love to go some other time again, preferably in the evening time...

Great scenery for taking photos and relaxing.

You can only wait for someone for 5 minutes without ordering and you can’t order water in the meantime. Otherwise staff would rudely ask you to leave even if you’ve explained you’re waiting for someone, especially if you’re a lady.

On Sundays (I think Fridays and Saturdays as well but not certain) their soft drinks, mock tails and beer menu is unavailable, you can only order cocktails, wines and spirits. They’ll allow you order soft drinks as mixers for spirits but not on its own. I find this very disturbing for nonalcoholics as their only option of drink is water and only if they order a meal or soft drink if companion is drinking alcohol and orders it as a mixer.

The food is subpar: the order took too long to arrive, the fries aren’t dry enough and the grilled fish is more like boiled fish with a lot of water in it. Flavours are average. At least the plating is nice if you want to take pictures of the not so great tasting food.

You get attitude from staff and they take too long to bring orders. They also won’t assist you getting sits if the place is crowded or if it rains and you have to move from the outdoor sitting to the small space with a bit of cover. So my advice is you don’t go in the rainy season.

This rating is for Naomi's Kitchen (the restaurant inside the lounge).

The lounge also has cool service and food.  However, the day I went there on a no-smoking day,  someone was still allowed to smoke shisha and other things. I believe that no longer happens.

The restaurant (Naomi's Kitchen) and food is dope

It's been a hard day of riding and we decided to take a break and grab a bite at ultima.
I had a greek yoghurt, someone else had a vanilla flavoured yoghurt, another had the amala and abula and someone had the jolloff rice portion.
Food was well cooked and tasty. The ice cream was reported to he really good and the yoghurt was just perfect.
Water was chilled and the atmosphere was comfortable and really friendly.
I was going r take umbrage when I saw the floor being mopped but the girl explained that we could go into another dining room whilst she finishedopoing the floor so all was well.
We finished our food and got ok out auoerbikes and roared off into the sunset...an experience not to be forgotten soon and an experience to be repeated really soon too.
There food were nice but it doesn't making sense eating inside heat, we understand the economy of the country, you can do better to get fan once since your outlet is a closed one.

When they say, staff that represent your brand , I had a lovely experience today 20th dec 2025. I and my hubby came from lagos to ibadan for a weeding, we were searching frantically for a place to eat, we drove pass a particular fast food and we were reversing and ultima was just a before them, ultima security guard named Abdul Rasheed, stopped us and said are we not eating, we said we were going to the next fast food, boy! he started advertising for Ultima, we should try them, he listed all the food they had , sincerely his marketing prowess got us, and did we regret it no! The food was vey good and the fresh juice was a bang.

Am giving 5 starts because they deserve it you can't believe local food can be gotten here even at lesser price as #500 it really surprising...
Talk of there services it wow so impressive
The only thing I guess it should be correct is the payment method not bad oooo but in case you are in hurry to eat food like amala and you have to queue to pay to me there is need for adjustment .. To my surprise I discussed this with the manager and he respond well with all surety that it will be attend to.
I love this place .

Food here is nice and fairly priced.
Restaurant is neat, staffs are polite and there's a restroom if you need one. Parking space is quite small.
Overall, a good place 👍🏽

I absolutely loved it here.
4 stars only because they didn’t have 2 of the items I wanted to order but the waitresses’ alternate suggestion was very well.
Delicious food and drinks, courteous and friendly staff, ambient environment.
Oh, yes…we need a mirror in that restroom please and thanks.
This review pertains to the restaurant. I didn’t get a chance to check out the lounge.
The reservation was pretty straightforward over WhatsApp as the website was down at the time I tried. The food came in fast and was on point.

Exquisite...
Had Greek Seafood Rice... So satisfying.
Try out the strawberry sunset drink... So good

And Rose was there to give us that excellent service... Taking time to  elaborate on the menu, attentive and smart babe.
A great staff...

The food was good but the service time was too long. Forty-five minutes waiting for a meal is rather long.
The price? Well, not too high.

I ate Ofada Reloaded and it was "okay", while my girlfriend went with their Pepper Soup which was missing plantains but was written on the menu that there will be.

Their milkshakes were nice actually but food takes long to be ready especially the Pepper Soup, like 65 minutes thereabout.

This location is a great place to spend time. The ambience is top-notch. They have really nice, classy and a wide range of delicacies, therefore giving you multiple options to select from. Their price is also quite friendly. There is a buzzer on each table that could be used to call the attendants so you don’t even have to stress to reach out when you have questions or need anything.

The only issue I have is with the location of the restroom. You will have to go downstairs if you have the need to use the restroom and it only accommodates a user at a time, which means that you might have to queue if there are others waiting in line to go in. Apart from that, the experience was very worthwhile.

I was here for my mom's birthday celebration. The food was better than we expected. The portions were large, we had to share and everything was delicious. The shrimp sauce could have been served in a bowl instead. We were also surprised that we got served freshly squeezed juice, which is rare. A plus for that.

The customer service can be better though. Maybe because they weren't expecting us even though we were just 4 or they were just setting up, it just seemed like they didn't have enough waiting staff. Only one ac was also working so that needs to be fixed.

We met an elderly man who seemed to be the manager/owner who offered my mom a complimentary wine bottle for her birthday. Overall it was a good time and they just need minor adjustments.

Great food!
The main meal takes a lot of time to come, about 30/45 minutes but the bobba tea, etc takes a lot less time.
Appetizers also don’t take so much time, and everything tastes good about 7/10.

I enjoyed the bubble tea it comes in different flavors, so you should try it. The chicken was spicy and tasty. It’s a great place for families, friends to enjoy meals together and I loved all my pictures.

An exquisite Chinese restaurant located in Ibadan. The members of staff are very friendly and were patient enough to explain the menu to us. The food was super amazing and quite affordable as well. They serve Chapman and soft drinks but no beer. Wines are also available if you would like to go for that. Would visit again and I totally recommend.

Martha's is great if you want a cozy and chill atmosphere to dine. The decor and ambience makes you feel at peace. I'd give them that

Getting your food (yes, even the appetizers) can take a while so if you're really hungry, I'd recommend snacking on something before going there. That said, the service was great — at least from my experience.  The waiters were nice, calm and professional

The food itself was really great for the price. I'd even say the food tasted better than the price?

In summary, I'd be visiting again and I recommend!

The food is good. The service is excellent but the atmosphere is whack. The fine dining experience is always ruined with noise and too loud music.
Martha’s is a restaurant and not a lounge/ club.

Nice place though small in size, parking lot and inside space are small, no wifi, no wheelchair parking lot, no armed security personnel, but outsourced security outfit, however, Marthas kitchen is superb with variety of local & intercontinental dishes, drinks and dessert. More enjoyable with family members, friends, colleagues, others. Just you know that Marthas kitchen is an upmarket resturant also having 15% vat deduction

This was my first visit here and I absolutely loved my experience here. From the reception to the atmosphere to the cool background music. Everything is specially curated. They know their onions when it comes to their food and drinks. A lovely place for a romantic date or a family date. I totally recommend.

The atmosphere was incredibly comfortable, with modern aesthetics that added to the charm of the place. The ambience was just right—inviting and stylish. I decided to try their special Chinese rice with curry sauce, and it was nothing short of heavenly! Every bite was a perfect blend of rich flavours, making the meal truly unforgettable. The combination of great food and a pleasant environment made for a fantastic dining experience.

It's a nice restaurant to dine in. You can seat in the main restaurant or their lounge upstairs. The food is great but you might have to wait for some time before it is ready. While you wait, you can order their starter and drink. You can get a great meal and drink for about 20,000 naira. Their menu is on their website.

Was definitely worth it.. Polite staff ensuring optimum satisfaction and flexibility. The ambience was warm and welcoming. They also have a private dining space. Didn't know such a place existed at Odoona. Would definitely recommend.
We had such a great experience at the restaurant. The staff were friendly and the atmosphere was welcoming. The food was delicious too. 👍🏾
Flora restaurant has a very nice ambience and customer service is very friendly. Food is really nice and affordable. Overall the place is a ten over ten. I’ll definitely be visiting again

First of all , you guys aesthetics and space are not all that for the kind of policies you have for your fine dining

The policies are so disturbing and distracting, your costumer care would have to talk and talk before one understands the policy

What do you mean It’s a must to order starter , main course and desert or cocktail .. then each person has to do that too?!!!!

The starters and main course self is a 2/10! I and my partner couldn’t even eat it .. Korean chicken wings and you are putting cabbage under it ???

Then additional 10% charge aside for vat  just because we are sitting in “fine dinning” with that low aesthetics?? Even jaz ibadan is way better off and didn’t do all these stress not to talk of Lagos restaurants

I wasted 50k with no value what so ever .. the policies are wack and disturbing for what you give!!!!

It was my first time eating in this restaurant and the first impression of it exceeded my expectations. It is a well furnished and neat place with good conditioning. I really loved my stay at the restaurant.

A beautiful and cozy environment with hospitable staff and very delicious meals👌🏻. I had their chicken and chips. It was mouth watering🤤. It is definitely good dining and worth the price. The place is perfect for a romantic hangout☺️. Also enough space for a bigger group.

Me and my friends stopped by Orbit RestoBar today and honestly, I was impressed. The place has such a cool and relaxed vibe, indoor and outdoor spaces that make you just want to sit and enjoy. It was so much fun for us….

The food was delicious and well put together, with a good mix of options on the menu. The ‘wise lady’ mocktail!! I totally recommend.

What really stood out for me today was the service mehn!! The staff were warm, attentive, and genuinely made me feel welcome.

I also love the fact that they are open round the clock, which makes it such a reliable spot for me really.

Overall, today’s visit was a really good experience and I’ll definitely be coming back again soon for sure!!

I strongly recommend.

Orbit Resto Bar is a great place to hang out with friends or just enjoy a nice meal. The food is delicious, the drinks are refreshing, and the atmosphere is lively but still comfortable. The staff are super friendly and attentive, which really makes the experience even better. Definitely coming back!
This place is really amazing. First, I must commend their staffs. They are very pleasant. Their food tasted really good and was nicely plated. I recommend 👌🏻

Had a lovely lunch date with my partner at Shandy's, and it was a great experience overall. The ambience is cozy and welcoming. We ordered Shandy's Special Fried Rice and Jollof Rice, both were flavorful and well-prepared. We wrapped things up with some ice cream which was a nice touch. It's definitely a spot worth visiting again!

Shandy's is a delightful gem that serves more than just food. The perfect background music sets the atmosphere just right, elevating the dining experience to a whole new level. The staff are courteous, genuinely warm and attentive. A standout, surprisingly, is their sauce - it's simply the best. Overall, a top-notch spot that marries taste, ambiance, and exceptional service flawlessly! Highly recommended.

The customer service was top notch!!!!! 20/10
And the food? Omg loved ittttt.
And prices? Things are expensive everywhere 😭sadly.
So great! Highly recommend

Updated review -

I guess they changed their chef or someone is out to sabotage their brand. They knowingly served me and my partner an obviously spoilt catfish pepper soup on the 25th. Immediately it arrived, I commented on the appearance as they tried to mask with copious amount of pepper and ridiculous spice that should not be in pepper soup. Once I tasted it, I almost threw up. Both plates were returned and they tried to make up with a free juice and fried fish.  I was so upset as I had stayed the whole day without food hoping to enjoy what I thought would be a lovely dinner. Why would you deliberately poison your customers?

Honestly, I doubt I would be back.

--------------------

Really tasty and delicious dishes.

Highly recommend their seafood okro, chicken salad and the catfish pepper soup was a 15/10 for me! 🌟

First off, when they said they open by 12 noon, they meant it. Got there earlier and I had to wait outside, with my toddler 😩 as I was meeting with a friend. We went there two days after Christmas and myself and my friend were the first customers. I’m a drink kinda person but unfortunately, they only had one choice of drink, Virgin Sunrise (took the non alcoholic one. Apparently they’ve same drink with alcohol). I’m not entirely sure what to make of that drink, it was pretty basic. My two-year old had ice cream (only vanilla flavor was available). When it was time to order our meals, my friend was helpful (she’s a regular). She ordered the fiery wings platter and I ordered for something half chicken (can’t remember what it is called). We waited a while before the food was served (we were the only customers at the time, just imagining what it’d be like if they had a full house) Meal was ok, a few burnt sides on the chicken but not bad. The chicken and rice was really spicy, my toddler couldn’t eat it.
Customer service was great, staff were great, took some videos and pictures of us. Will I go there again? Yeah, probably to try something else on their menu. Was the food worth the price? Yeah.

I had a lovely time at Jaf cafe and restaurant. The environment is neat, beautiful and serene. The service was excellent, the staff were courteous and willing to help.
Reservations have to be made in advance, the food came within the stipulated time frame we were given, which was about 30 minutes.

Nestled in the bustling heart of Dugbe, Ibadan, Heritage Mall Ibadan stands as the crown jewel among shopping malls in Ibadan. The Bush House Arena is a vibrant grill restaurant, lounge & entertainment hub located in the Independence Layout area of Enugu, Nigeria. It is widely recognized for its lively atmosphere, expertly grilled dishes & status as a popular evening hangout spot for both locals & tourists. Nestled in the heart of Independence Layout, it offers a captivating dining experience that showcases the rich flavors of Nigerian cuisine. Located in 42 Nza Street, Independence Layout, Enugu. The arena is open daily, with slightly extended hours on Wednesday & Friday nights: Monday - Tuesday: 8:00 AM – 11:30 PM & Wednesday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 AM. Thursday is from 8:00 AM – 11:30 PM while Friday is 8:00 AM – 12:00 AM. Saturday - Sunday is 8:00 AM – 11:30 PM. The place specializes in Nigerian cuisine, particularly grilled goat meat (a local favorite), succulent beef skewers, & spicy grilled chicken etc. Perfectly situated in Independence Layout, but also close to the New Haven District of the town, this grill restaurant is not just a meal stop, but a culinary journey that captures the essence of Enugu & the eastern region. The venue features a large open-air sit-out area, pool tables (snooker) & viewing centers with large flat screen televisions for live football matches. Also, it often hosts karaoke nights (typically Fridays) & live music displays on select nights. The bar boasts an extensive drinks menu (cocktails, local drinks, & wine), restroom facilities, & both free & paid exclusive parking options. Generally, the environment is "cosy," & "safe,".  It is highly recommended for group outings, dates, & family gatherings. The outfit is outstanding for it's vibrant flavors with authentic taste of Nigeria, especially the grill restaurant & offerings of delicious indigenous meals in a very lively atmosphere. The favourite offerings are the grilled goat meat & fresh fish peppersoup. The fresh fish peppersoup commences with the customer having to point out the preferred fish from a pond containing numerous fishes, alive & swimming around. Then the preparation of the fish meal commences. Usually the process takes about 45 minutes - one hour. Worth the wait while you take your drinks, I will say. The weekends normally have live music & other entertainments to create a festive atmosphere. Though the facility is massive, but it won't be a bad idea to make a reservation for larger groups to ensure good seating. The ambiance is vibrant & welcoming, whether one is a casual diner or for those celebrating special occasions. Whether you desire spicy grilled chicken, succulent beef skewers, or vegetarian options, there is something to satisfy every palate. The meals are complemented with refreshing beverages, including local drinks that enhance the dining experience. To this regard, fresh palmwine is always available. Even the restaurant’s decor reflects the local culture, providing an immersive experience that connects to the region’s history & traditions. One of the highlights of dining at Bush House Arena is the opportunity to experience the local flavors through their signature dishes. Whether you're enjoying a meal with family or friends, the warmth of the place is commendable. There're numerous staff deployed to attend to customers. They are uniformed for ease of identification & usually assigned to specific tables to attend to diners. This makes administration very easy & seamless. The staff are uniformed, very polite & attentive. I commend the establishment on this arrangement. The arena mostly has an open air arrangement with it's spacious layout coupled with spectacular architecture & engineering which allows for relaxed dining & lounging. There is ample parking spaces available & uniformed security personnel employed around the facility. Bush House Arena is definitely a delightful experience that captures the rich culinary heritage of Enugu & the region in general

From Nostalgia to Now — Polo Park Through My Eyes

Born and bred in Enugu, Polo Park was part of our weekend thrills growing up. It was more open, green, and laid-back — a perfect place to run around as kids and enjoy the breezy charm of the city.

Today, Polo Park Mall has evolved into a modern shopping hub, with fashion stores, eateries, a cinema, and more. It’s a bold attempt to blend heritage with modern lifestyle — and I commend that. Still, I can’t help but miss the old, airy Polo grounds. The crowds, traffic, and commercial buzz are a far cry from the serenity we knew.

But change is constant, and the mall offers value for both locals and visitors. It’s still a landmark in Enugu — just one wearing a new face.
