Roban Stores has multiple branches in Enugu, offering a wide range of products including groceries, electronics & clothing. The parent company is known as Roban Group, which consists of Roban Hotels & Roban Stores. Regarding the stores, there're 3 located in Enugu, Enugu State, Nigeria. There locations are; 105 Agbani Rd, Achara Layout, Enugu, Nomeh Drive, Trans-Ekulu, Enugu & the Roban Stores located in 1C Bisala Road, Independence Layout, Enugu. The Stores in Independence Layout is the subject of this review. It operates just as the 2 other sister stores, opening between  9:00 AM - 8:30 PM Monday to Saturday & closed on Sundays. This location features a popular shawarma spot & is also known for having a wide variety of items from clothing to electronics, to groceries & home essentials etc. The stores is known as a one-stop retail destination carrying virtually everything needed in a home. The categories of available products include; for groceries, you have cereals, dairy products, cooking oil, fresh fruits, vegetables etc. Coming to the bakery, there is  fresh bread, cookies, their popular chicken pies etc. Regarding there extensive fashion & cosmetics, you have assorted men's, women's, & children's wears, perfumes, watches, lotions, shower gels etc. Coming to home essentials & electronics, you have kitchen hardware, household interior decorations, electronics, generators etc. There're also other Items, like beverages, wine & drinks, baby & toddler items, sporting equipment, toys, books etc. The chicken pie from the bakery is simply delicious & children love it. No doubt that Roban Stores is considered as a great one-stop shopping hub for household items/appliances, groceries, clothings etc. The store is always buzzing with shoppers. Inside the store, one will observe the good arrangement of shelves & display of goods according to categories. All well labeled for ease of identification. Virtually everything one will need in a home is available here. An army of uniformed staff comprising stewards, check-out payment operators, cleaning crew, supervisors (they're usually not in uniform) & security personnel are all ubiquitous. They're always professional in the discharge of there duties. The check-out security procedures are stringent as the security staff match the goods one is carrying to the issued receipt. With all this heavy traffic, the store is usually very clean. In fact, as you're shopping, you will equally notice cleaning staff constantly working. Coming to parking spaces, though the designated area is not so big, but it usually suffices as the security staff ensure everyone has a space to squeeze into. Without doubt, Roban Stores is one of the leading retailers in Nigeria. I give that recognition to them

I went there around 10:15 AM 26/05/2025
just to shop, but what I experienced left me angry, embarrassed, and honestly, deeply disappointed.

First, I asked a staff member to confirm the price of an item, and the response I got was: “Go and use your calculator.” I couldn’t believe it. Still, I let it go especially after another staff apologized. I went ahead, got the items I needed, paid at the counter, and was leaving.

Then came the worst part.

As I stepped outside, the security guard ran after me, shouting at me to show him what I was carrying. He said it like I had stolen something, in public. In broad daylight. In front of others. I was shocked, humiliated, and furious.

I asked him, “Why would you want to check what I already paid for?” He had no answer. I demanded a refund immediately. To my surprise, he angrily snatched the bag from me and handed it to the cashier. Their excuse? “We’re checking if we made a mistake.” Really? With a computerized system?

As if that wasn’t enough, a woman who I believe is their supervisor came down, insulted me again, and went upstairs to process the refund with not even the slightest show of remorse.

This isn’t how you treat people. Not anywhere in the world. There are cameras there, and I truly hope the management checks the footage and sees how badly I was treated.
